Overview

Consilio is a global leader in legal consulting and services, helping corporate legal departments and law firms transform operations through technology, process optimisation, and data-driven strategies. Our Ironclad Practice delivers end-to-end Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) implementations, combining legal expertise with structured, scalable delivery methodologies.

Consilio is seeking an experienced Ironclad Project Manager to lead end-to-end client implementations within our Ironclad Practice.

You will operate within a structured delivery team, working closely with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and Legal Engineers to ensure successful execution of Ironclad CLM deployments. This role is responsible for owning project delivery, ensuring alignment to scope, timelines, and quality standards, while driving collaboration across technical and business stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Governance

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of Ironclad CLM implementations across multiple client engagements
  • Define and manage project scope, timelines, milestones, and deliverables
  • Monitor project performance, proactively managing risks, issues, and dependencies
  • Ensure delivery aligns with agreed Statement of Work (SOW), budget, and quality expectations

Delivery Team Coordination

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams including Solution Architects, Legal Engineers, and Delivery Managers
  • Ensure clear roles, responsibilities, and accountability across the delivery lifecycle
  • Facilitate sprint planning, stand-ups, and status reporting within agile or hybrid delivery models
  • Support resource planning and utilisation in collaboration with Delivery leadership

Client Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle
  • Build strong relationships with Legal, Procurement, Sales, and IT teams
  • Provide regular status updates, executive reporting, and steering committee communications
  • Manage client expectations and drive alignment on priorities and outcomes

Implementation Oversight

  • Oversee the delivery of Ironclad configurations, workflows, integrations, and data migration activities
  • Collaborate with Solution Architects to ensure designs are implemented effectively
  • Ensure successful completion of key phases including discovery, build, testing, UAT, and go-live

Risk & Change Management

  • Identify, track, and mitigate project risks and issues
  • Manage scope changes, ensuring proper governance and documentation
  • Support change management and user adoption strategies for successful rollout

Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement

  • Ensure adherence to Consilio delivery standards, methodologies, and best practices
  • Drive high-quality outputs across all phases of implementation
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of delivery frameworks, tools, and templates within the Ironclad Practice

Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience managing CLM or SaaS implementation projects (Ironclad strongly preferred)
  • Strong understanding of contract lifecycle management (CLM) and legal operations processes
  • Experience working in cross-functional delivery teams (Project Managers, Architects, Engineers)
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a client-facing environment
  • Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience delivering Ironclad CLM implementations
  • Background in legal technology, consulting, or professional services
  • Familiarity with enterprise systems such as Salesforce, DocuSign, Microsoft ecosystem, or integration platforms
  • Experience with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Smartsheet, Asana, MS Project)
  • PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or equivalent certification

Soft Skills

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including executive-level engagement
  • Strong organisational and planning capabilities
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive clarity across complex projects
  • Proactive, solutions-focused mindset with strong problem-solving skills
  • Collaborative approach with the ability to lead cross-functional teams

What You’ll Be Part Of

  • A high-performing Ironclad Practice delivering global CLM implementations
  • A structured delivery model alongside Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and Legal Engineers
  • A collaborative, fast-paced environment focused on innovation and client impact

Why Join Consilio?

At Consilio, you will play a central role in delivering transformative legal technology solutions. As part of our Ironclad Practice, you’ll lead complex implementations, work with global clients, and shape the future of legal operations through best-in-class CLM delivery.

raw.title: Sr Product Manager
raw.excerpt: Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.
raw.description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

Product management is changing. The best product managers no longer just write requirements and wait for engineering; they prototype their own ideas, pressure-test them with data, and use AI to move from problem to validated solution in days rather than quarters. We are looking for senior product managers who have internalized that shift and who want to apply it to one of the biggest unsolved problems in America: helping working people save for retirement.

You will own the product strategy for a meaningful surface area, lead a roadmap for a dedicated engineering team, and partner across Engineering, Design, Operations, Revenue, Customer Success, and Compliance to deliver accurate, timely, and transparent outcomes at scale. You will do this as an AI-augmented builder: using modern AI tooling both to sharpen how you work and to shape products that increasingly work on our customers’ behalf.

What you get to do every day

  • Own the vision and strategy for your product area end to end. Set a clear, opinionated direction, define the outcomes that matter, and rally your team and stakeholders behind a roadmap that delivers a great customer experience while achieving business goals and satisfying regulatory requirements.
  • Define and own the goals that measure success, quantify the business impact of what you ship, and rigorously track and report progress on a weekly and monthly basis.
  • Produce artifacts that unblock engineering teams to deliver high-quality work on time.
  • Partner with other product teams so your solutions deliver a great end-to-end platform experience, not just a strong local one.
  • Dig into the data from first principles, form a point of view, and use it to validate assumptions and drive decisions.
  • Navigate tradeoffs and negotiate timelines with internal and external stakeholders, communicating with precision in both writing and conversation.

How you work with AI

We expect our senior product managers to use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster, and to bring good judgment about where AI belongs in the product itself.

  • Prototype rapidly. Use tools such as Figma Make, Claude Code, Codex, or similar to explore, validate, and demonstrate new ideas yourself, so you can align a team on direction with a working artifact rather than a document.
  • Compress the busywork. Apply AI to speed up research synthesis, requirements drafting, data exploration, and analysis so you spend your time on judgment, strategy, and customer understanding.
  • Build AI into the product. Identify where copilots, agents, and intelligent automation genuinely improve the customer experience, and partner with engineering on what to build and how it should behave across success, failure, and edge cases.

What you bring to the role

  • Experience: 5+ years of product management experience, including owning a roadmap for a dedicated engineering team in a technical product area. Experience with financial or other regulated products is a strong plus.
  • AI fluency: Demonstrated, hands-on use of AI tools to build and transform how you work, not just as a chatbot. You are comfortable vibe-coding front-end and UX changes yourself, and you can point to prototypes or interfaces where AI meaningfully changed the outcome or the pace.
  • Builder mindset: High agency and high urgency. You own problems end to end, turn zero-to-one ideas into real products, and do whatever it takes to execute complex projects.
  • Technical partnership: You have partnered closely with engineers on complex systems at scale, can self-sufficiently root-cause issues, and can propose credible fixes.
  • Analytical rigor: You are data-driven and think from first principles, and you are equally excited about 100 percent accuracy and 99 percent timeliness.
  • Business acumen: You enjoy digging into how a business works, identifying how to make it better, and building product and technical solutions to do so.
  • Communication: Crisp, high-attention-to-detail written and verbal communication, with the ability to make complex technical concepts clear to any audience.
  • Education: Degree in Computer Science, Business, or a related field.

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.

  • Customer obsession: We're all about creating amazing experiences for our customers. We put their needs first and go the extra mile to make them smile.
  • Long-Term Orientation: We're not just playing for today; we're building a legacy. We think big, plan strategically, and invest in our future.
  • Autonomous and Accountable Teams: We trust our team members to take ownership and make smart decisions. We empower you to be your best self!
  • An Escalating Bar for Talent and Performance: We're constantly raising the bar and challenging ourselves to be better. We believe in growth and continuous improvement.
  • Fundamental Optimism: We see the glass as half full (and then we fill it up with more amazing ideas!). We believe in the power of positivity and the potential for greatness.

Compensation - At Human Interest, there are a number of factors that are used to determine the appropriate pay range for each position. We take into account the cost of labor for each position in various markets across the U.S. The base salary for this position spans $171,000 - $207,000and represents the minimum in our lowest geographic region to a maximumin our highest geographic region. The salary we offer to a new employee within this range is based on their location within the U.S., their relevant job-related skills, and experience. At Human Interest, base salary is one component of the overall total rewards package. Depending on the position, additional compensation components such as bonuses, commissions, and equity may be offered. All of our employees are offered a robust suite of physical, financial, and mental wellness benefits. In compliance with applicable laws, we do not inquire about salary history, or about criminal history prior to a conditional offer of employment.

Benefits -

  • A great 401(k) plan: Our own! Our 401(k) includes a dollar-for-dollar employer match up to 4% of compensation (immediately vested) and $0 plan fees
  • Top-of-the-line health plans, as well as dental and vision insurance
  • Competitive time off and parental leave
  • Addition Wealth: Unlimited access to digital tools, financial professionals, and a knowledge center to help you understand your equity and support your financial wellness
  • Lyra: Enhanced Mental Health Support for Employees and dependents
  • Carrot: Fertility healthcare and family forming benefits
  • Candidly: Student loan resource to help you and your family plan, borrow, and repay student debt
  • Monthly work-from-home stipend; quarterly lifestyle stipend
  • Engaging team-building experiences, ranging from virtual social events to team offsites, promoting collaboration and camaraderie.

We’re a great place to work (but don’t take our word for it)

Here’s a list of our awards and accolades:

  • Certified as a Great Place To Work® (2023-2025)
  • Fortune Best Place to Work in the Bay Area (2024)
  • Best Places to Work by Built In (2023-2024)
  • America’s Best Startup Employers by Forbes (2020-2022, 2024)
  • A Top Company by Y Combinator (2020-2023)
  • Inc. Fastest Growing Companies (2021)

Human Interest is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran or military status, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected under federal, state, or local laws. Employment with Human Interest is at-will, meaning either you or the company may terminate employment at any time, with or without cause or notice, except as otherwise provided by law or written agreement.

We are committed to making every stage of our application process fully accessible to all individuals. If you need a reasonable accommodation at any point in the process, please let us know at applicantaccommodations@humaninterest.com.

Protect yourself against fraud and identity theft. Apply to our open positions directly via our careers page on Greenhouse. Human Interest will never ask applicants for their financial or banking information as part of our application process. All legitimate communication will come from a @humaninterest.com email address. If you have questions, please reach out to us directly at careers@humaninterest.com

Please note Human Interest does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from candidates. We will not consider resumes from vendors, including and without limitation search firms, staffing agencies, fee-based referral services, and recruiting agencies.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment-qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We comply withCCPAguidelines.

Senior IT Architect | IT Architectural Engineering Services

Location: Remote – Available across U.S. and Puerto Rico

Clearance Level: Public Trust (ADP/IT-II); Tier 3 Investigation (NACLC)
Citizenship: U.S. Citizenship required

Summary

We are seeking candidates for a potential opportunity as Senior IT Architect to join our team supporting the Defense Health Agency's (DHA) enterprise IT infrastructure. This role leads the design and development of scalable, secure, and interoperable IT systems that align with mission-critical healthcare delivery and readiness operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design architectural and technical solutions for enterprise-scale infrastructure supporting both on-premise and MED365 cloud environments.

  • Develop strategies and documentation that guide engineering implementation and architectural consistency across DHA systems.

  • Ensure system designs are interoperable, sustainable, and aligned with DHA Enterprise Architecture policies and governance.

  • Lead or support functional and technical requirements validation, including Requirements Worksheets (RWs) and Governance input.

  • Facilitate iRAM and RAM sessions and coordinate with SMEs, IA staff, and stakeholders during solution development.

  • Conduct feasibility and architectural assessments to ensure compliance with cybersecurity, scalability, and performance standards.

  • Draft and maintain Test and Evaluation Strategies (TES) to support operational readiness.

  • Manage architectural documentation throughout the systems lifecycle and provide support during acquisition planning.

  • Deliver Department of Defense Architecture Framework (DoDAF) artifacts to meet governance and compliance standards.

  • Lead re-architecture efforts for fielded solutions based on mission needs or system limitations.

  • Collaborate with DoD, MHS, and industry stakeholders to align technical direction and solve architecture/integration challenges.

Preferred Tools & Skills

  • DoDAF, RMF, and other DoD/ITIL architectural standards

  • Microsoft Visio, Enterprise Architect (or similar modeling/design tools)

  • Experience with Azure or other hybrid cloud platforms (e.g., MED365)

  • Technical writing and documentation skills

  • Systems Engineering and Requirements Management background

  • Familiarity with Agile and DevSecOps methodologies

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven experience leading IT architecture and systems design efforts within complex enterprise environments.

  • Knowledge of DHA, MHS, or DoD IT environments and governance processes.

  • Strong ability to translate mission needs into scalable architectural solutions.

  • U.S. Citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain Public Trust (Tier 3/NACLC) clearance.

Education & Certifications

  • Required (Foundational – one of the following):

    • Bachelor’s degree in IT / Cybersecurity / Data Science / IS / CS (ABET or CAE accredited),

    • OR CISSP.

  • Required (CE – one of the following):

    • Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305),

    • OR Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100).

Job Summary:
We are seeking a Storage Engineer with deep expertise across enterprise storage platforms — NetApp ONTAP, Pure Storage, and Ceph — to design, deploy, and operate the storage foundation that supports our compute, virtualization, database, and Kubernetes workloads. The role spans block, file, and object storage across data center, edge, and cloud environments, with strong attention to performance, data protection, and cost. The ideal candidate has operated heterogeneous storage estates at scale, understands the storage characteristics of diverse workloads, and brings strong automation discipline to storage engineering work.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and operate enterprise storage platforms across NetApp ONTAP, Pure Storage FlashArray/FlashBlade, and Ceph.
  • Implement and manage SAN, NAS, and object storage across data center and cloud environments.
  • Build storage solutions for VMware, Kubernetes (CSI drivers), and database workloads.
  • Design and operate replication, snapshot, and backup strategies for critical data assets.
  • Implement and operate cloud-tiered storage with FabricPool, CloudVolumes, or equivalent.
  • Build storage automation using Ansible, Terraform, REST APIs, and platform-native automation.
  • Operate Ceph clusters including OSD lifecycle, CRUSH maps, RGW, RBD, and CephFS.
  • Design and operate storage performance management for high-throughput and latency-sensitive workloads.
  • Implement data protection strategies including ransomware protection and immutable snapshots.
  • Build storage observability across capacity, performance, and health dimensions, surfacing the signals operators need to spot capacity pressure, performance regressions, and failing components before users feel the impact.
  • Lead storage upgrades, firmware lifecycle management, and security patching across the storage estate, planning each campaign to maintain availability for the workloads dependent on the platform.
  • Drive storage cost optimization including deduplication, compression, and tiering strategies.
  • Troubleshoot complex storage issues spanning array, network, and host layers.
  • Stay current with storage industry developments and emerging platforms, regularly review release notes and community discussions, and translate noteworthy advances into concrete recommendations and adoption proposals for the team.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of enterprise storage engineering experience.
  • Deep expertise in NetApp ONTAP or Pure Storage FlashArray/FlashBlade.
  • Hands-on experience with Ceph at production scale.
  • Strong understanding of SAN, NAS, and object storage protocols.
  • Experience with storage integration for VMware and Kubernetes (CSI).
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using Ansible, Terraform, or REST APIs.
  • Strong understanding of storage performance, capacity planning, and cost optimization.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across storage, network, and host layers.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Vendor certifications (NCDA, NCIE, Pure Storage certifications).
  • Experience with hybrid-cloud storage replication.
  • Familiarity with software-defined storage platforms beyond Ceph.
  • Experience with object storage at petabyte scale.
  • Exposure to AI/ML workloads with extreme I/O requirements.

Our mission is to be the catalyst for massive, measurable, data-informed healthcare improvement through data, analytics, and world-class expertise.

As Business Manager, you build and operate the business models, scenarios, and forecasts that inform how Health Catalyst invests, prices, and grows across its product and services portfolio. This is a strategic, high-impact role partnering with the Chief of Staff and senior leaders to turn strategy into rigorous, decision-ready analysis.

To succeed, you should be fluent in business and financial modeling, scenario planning, and forecasting, comfortable developing business cases for new and existing offerings, and able to distill complex analysis into clear recommendations for executive and Board audiences.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain integrated business models, P&L scenarios, and forecasts that inform strategic, investment, and pricing decisions across the product and services portfolio

  • Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses, scenario plans, and business cases with clear assumptions, sensitivities, and recommendations

  • Develop business cases for new offerings, investments, and portfolio changes — quantifying market opportunity, unit economics, and risk

  • Partner with Finance, Product, and Go-To-Market leaders to pressure-test growth, margin, and portfolio decisions

  • Support annual operating and long-range planning cycles, contributing models and inputs that shape leadership and Board materials

  • Define and track the KPIs and unit economics that connect strategy to operating performance

  • Synthesize market, competitive, and internal data into clear, actionable insights for the CEO and executive team

  • Prepare executive-ready analyses, presentations, and recommendations for the Chief of Staff, CEO, and Board

Recommended Skills and Experience

  • MBA (or equivalent) plus 5+ years in business strategy, strategic finance/FP&A, corporate strategy, management consulting, or a comparable analytical role

  • Demonstrated expertise building and operating business and financial models, scenario analyses, and forecasts

  • Must have hands-on experience leveraging Generative AI, applying current industry best practices to accelerate modeling, analysis, and decision support

  • Experience in technology businesses, ideally spanning both product (e.g., SaaS) and services portfolios

  • Strong command of business-case development, unit economics, and evidence-based recommendations

  • Proven ability to communicate and present complex analysis to senior executives (written, verbal, visual)

  • A passion for healthcare and the role Health Catalyst plays in making massive, measurable, data-informed improvements through data and analytics

  • Healthcare or healthcare IT experience a plus; advanced Excel and PowerPoint required, BI tools (e.g., Power BI) a plus

  • Results-oriented self-starter who collaborates effectively across teams and maintains a respectful work environment

  • Maintain compliance with training directives required by the organizationpertaining toInformation Security, Acceptable UsePolicyand HIPAA Privacy and Security.

  • Adhere to and comply with organizations Acceptable Use Policy

  • Safeguard information system assets byidentifyingand reporting potential and actual security events to theorganizationsSecurity and Compliance Officers.

English Proficiency:Advanced (C1/C2) – Excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.

Schedule:Full-Time | Flexible schedule with availability to collaborate across international time zones.

Start Date: As Soon As Possible

About the Company

This opportunity is with a fast-growing global influencer marketing and creator strategy agency that helps brands build authentic connections with audiences through strategic creator partnerships. The company specializes in designing and executing influencer campaigns for international brands, managing every stage of the process from creator sourcing and negotiations to campaign execution, performance reporting, and strategic consulting.

Working with clients across multiple industries and global markets, the organization combines creativity, data-driven decision-making, and strong relationship management to deliver measurable marketing results. Its collaborative and entrepreneurial culture offers team members the opportunity to work with leading content creators while shaping innovative campaigns across today's fastest-growing digital platforms.

About the Role

We're looking for a strategic, relationship-driven, and highly organized Influencer Marketing Manager to lead the development and execution of influencer marketing initiatives for global brands.

In this role, you'll be responsible for creating influencer strategies, identifying and managing creator partnerships, negotiating contracts, overseeing campaign execution, analyzing performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to maximize campaign success. You'll play a key role in strengthening brand awareness, increasing audience engagement, and building long-term relationships with creators and brand ambassadors.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced digital environment and is passionate about influencer marketing, content strategy, and social media innovation.

What You'll Do

Influencer Strategy & Campaign Planning

  • Develop and execute comprehensive influencer marketing strategies aligned with brand and business objectives.
  • Define campaign goals, creator strategies, deliverables, timelines, and KPIs.
  • Identify opportunities to increase brand awareness, engagement, and campaign performance.
  • Continuously optimize influencer programs using campaign insights and industry trends.

Creator & Talent Management

  • Identify, recruit, onboard, and manage relationships with influencers, creators, and brand ambassadors.
  • Build long-term partnerships with creators across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, blogs, and emerging platforms.
  • Maintain strong relationships with agencies, talent representatives, and creator networks.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for influencer partnerships.

Campaign Execution

  • Manage influencer campaigns from strategy through execution and reporting.
  • Coordinate campaign briefings, content creation, approvals, publishing schedules, and deliverables.
  • Ensure campaigns are delivered on time, within budget, and according to client expectations.
  • Monitor campaign progress and proactively resolve issues throughout execution.

Negotiation & Budget Management

  • Negotiate influencer contracts, compensation, deliverables, and usage rights.
  • Manage campaign budgets and ensure cost-effective execution.
  • Monitor campaign spending and maximize return on investment.

Analytics & Performance Reporting

  • Track campaign performance using engagement, reach, conversions, ROI, and other KPIs.
  • Analyze campaign data and generate actionable insights.
  • Prepare client reports, presentations, and strategic recommendations.
  • Continuously improve campaign performance through data-driven decision-making.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with social media, PR, creative, product, and marketing teams.
  • Integrate influencer marketing initiatives into broader marketing campaigns.
  • Support campaign planning, product launches, and brand initiatives.

Industry Research & Compliance

  • Stay current on influencer marketing trends, platform updates, and emerging creators.
  • Ensure influencer content complies with brand guidelines, FTC regulations, and legal requirements.
  • Research new tools, technologies, and best practices within the influencer marketing industry.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in influencer marketing, digital marketing, social media management, or creator partnerships.
  • Proven experience planning and executing successful influencer marketing campaigns.
  • Strong negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Experience using influencer marketing platforms such as CreatorIQ, Traackr, AspireIQ, or similar tools.
  • Experience with Google Analytics and campaign reporting.
  • Deep understanding of social media platforms, creator ecosystems, and digital content trends.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate campaign data into actionable insights.
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.
  • Knowledge of FTC guidelines and influencer marketing compliance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within consumer goods, retail, beauty, fashion, technology, or lifestyle industries.
  • Existing network of creators, influencers, agencies, or talent managers.
  • Experience integrating influencer campaigns with paid social media advertising.
  • Experience managing international influencer campaigns.
  • Strong content creation, copywriting, or visual storytelling skills.
  • Digital Marketing or Influencer Marketing certifications.
  • Experience with online reputation management or digital crisis communications.

Candidate Evaluation Considerations

To ensure success in this role, the following factors will be carefully evaluated during the selection process:

  • Experience leading influencer marketing campaigns from strategy through reporting.
  • Ability to build long-term creator and client relationships.
  • Negotiation and partnership management skills.
  • Knowledge of influencer marketing platforms and campaign analytics.
  • Strong understanding of social media platforms and digital marketing trends.
  • Organization, project management, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Strategic thinking and ability to optimize campaign performance.
  • Professionalism, communication skills, and collaborative mindset.

What Success Looks Like

  • Influencer campaigns consistently achieve or exceed performance objectives.
  • Strong relationships are developed with creators, agencies, and brand partners.
  • Campaigns are delivered on schedule and within approved budgets.
  • Performance reporting provides valuable insights and strategic recommendations.
  • Brand awareness, engagement, and campaign ROI continue to improve.
  • Long-term influencer partnerships contribute to sustained brand growth and customer loyalty.

Why Join Us?

  • Lead influencer marketing campaigns for international brands.
  • Collaborate with creators across today's leading digital platforms.
  • Work in a fast-paced, innovative, and collaborative environment.
  • Gain exposure to global influencer marketing strategies and multi-market campaigns.
  • Expand your expertise in creator partnerships, campaign strategy, and digital marketing.
  • Fully remote work environment with long-term career growth opportunities.

Important Notes

Applications may receive priority consideration if candidates:

  • Have direct experience managing global influencer marketing campaigns.
  • Have worked with CreatorIQ, Traackr, AspireIQ, or similar influencer platforms.
  • Bring an existing network of creators, influencers, or talent agencies.
  • Possess advanced English communication skills.
  • Have experience within consumer goods, beauty, fashion, retail, or technology.
  • Have successfully managed multiple campaigns and budgets simultaneously.

This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.

Description

CapsLock is a dynamic marketing company providing IT-enabled solutions for large North American partners. We specialize in scalable customer acquisition through data-driven marketing, creative production, and technology innovation.

Our teams collaborate across marketing, IT, analytics, and media buying to build, test, and optimize high-performing funnels that help clients achieve predictable growth across industries such as Home Improvement, Health, Legal, and Insurance.

Role Overview

We’re looking for an AI Video Editor Team Lead who is equal parts strong leader, project manager, systems builder, and editing geek — someone who knows how to automate workflows and achieve business goals through videos that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 to 7 editors and elevate them through mature management, strict quality control, and deep AI integration.

Core Responsibilities

Team & Project Management

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 7+ AI-driven video editors, identifying their core strengths and guiding them to new professional heights.
  • Monitor team morale and proactively manage workloads to prevent burnout, ensuring the team’s spirit aligns with the company culture.
  • Act as a strong Project Manager: own the task distribution process and handle complex project routing. Keep pipelines organized and ensure clean, on-time delivery.
  • Ensure strict Quality Control (QC). Every video must meet our high standards for pacing, visual fidelity, and hook impact.
  • Review, approve, and uphold internal guidelines and editing rules so the team has a clear operational framework.

AI Systems & Workflow Automation

  • Build systematized AI workflows. Create structured templates using tools like Weavy to speed up the team's execution.
  • Automate post-production. Build pipelines connecting task databases to AI generators, auto-delivering ready-to-edit assets directly, eliminating manual prompt copying and file downloading.
  • Integrate new AI tools. Regularly test emerging AI models and implement the most effective ones into the daily workflow.
  • Stay hands-on. Jump into the editing software (Adobe Suite) when needed to unblock the team, fix complex issues, or test new technical approaches.

Performance

  • Build and maintain a database of top-performing creatives to systematically scale and iterate on winning concepts.
  • Analyze failed creatives to understand what went wrong and make corrections for future videos.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and Marketers to align on technical feasibility, negotiate deadlines, and solve bottlenecks.
  • Actively participate in brainstorming sessions, pitching new visual formats and AI-driven approaches to turn creative hypotheses into reality.

Requirements

Requirements

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed video production/editing teams. (This is not a role for a senior editor looking for their first management gig).
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches.
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses.
  • Editing Geek: Deep, hands-on expertise in the Adobe Creative Cloud suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects). You know the editing world inside out and can troubleshoot or solve any technical problem the team encounters.
  • AI & Automation Geek: This is far beyond basic ChatGPT prompting. You actively track the latest AI video tools and integrate them to automate manual workflows. You know exactly how to create realistic AI avatars with perfect lip-sync, generate missing footage from scratch, anduse AI to solve any production problem.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: Solid understanding of short-form video ads (Meta, TikTok, YouTube Shorts). You know what keeps viewers watching and what makes a video sell.
  • Fluent English — both spoken and written.

Why do we deserve your attention?

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

Remote Work

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

Paid Time Off

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

Ongoing Learning

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

Home Office

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

Physical Well-Being

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

Unlimited Sick Days

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

Medical Coverage

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

Co-Working Space

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

Fun Stuff

From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.

This is a full-cycle, quota-carrying individual contributor role — you'll source and qualify your own pipeline, run the sales process end to end, and close new business across DTC, retail, and ecommerce accounts. You'll step into an established sales motion and playbook, working alongside the Sales Director and existing AEs to expand coverage and accelerate pipeline across the US market.

  • Prospect and build a healthy pipeline through outbound outreach, targeted campaigns, and inbound lead qualification across an assigned territory of DTC, omnichannel retail, and ecommerce accounts.

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field.
  • US-based with willingness to travel up to 15–25% for customer meetings and industry events.

raw.description:
ABOUT OPORTUN

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $21.3 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

WORKING AT OPORTUN

Working at Oportun means enjoying a differentiated experience of being part of a team that fosters a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture where we all feel a sense of belonging and are encouraged to share our perspectives. This inclusive culture is directly connected to our organization's performance and ability to fulfill our mission of delivering affordable credit to those left out of the financial mainstream. We celebrate and nurture our inclusive culture through our employee resource groups.

JOB SUMMARY

The Repossession and Remarketing Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the repossession of vehicles and the subsequent remarketing and sale of the repossessed assets. This includes managing multiple vendor relationships, adhering to regulatory guidelines, and ensuring the repo and remarketing agents are meeting and exceeding core KPI’s. The Repossession and Remarketing Supervisor will be responsible for hiring, training, developing and performance managing the team in a remote environment

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Personally responsible for the day-to-day operations and overall performance. Perform hiring, training, progressive discipline, and termination activities.
  • Develop strategic remarketing processes and relationships. Interactions may include operational performance reviews, issue resolution, informed of market conditions and customer needs response.
  • Managing vendor relationships, for example, assignment, storage, transportation, and auction vendor to include validation of services, disputes, and complaints.
  • Develop solutions: "sells", but also develops strategic solutions, creating true added value. Oversees daily pre-sale reviews and works closely to ensure vehicle attributes are updated to maximize vehicle value and update floors to reflect trending values.
  • Manage and protect collateral to ensure efficient and effective process is followed for every vehicle
  • Review inventory regularly to validate success from auction assignment to time sold
  • Ensure legal sale date has expired, vehicle has been transported & secured at auction, collaborate with other teams for holds to be removed accordingly, and coordinate with the Titles department to ensure titles are sent to and received by the auctions
  • Coordinate and ensure proper documentation for all vehicle redemptions
  • Establish timely scheduling of vehicles for sale at the auction, ensuring processes are completed within expected timeframes
  • Perform audits before and after sale to validate expenses are proper and approved where needed
  • Establish and maintain excellent service to internal and external partners to enhance recoveries and/or improve efficiencies
  • Protect interest of company by ensuring actions are in compliance regarding organizational goals, objectives, policies and procedures, and state and federal laws to ensure performance standards are achieved and maintained
  • Manage team responsible for closing deals to sell vehicles on time and for the best pricing possible. Responsible for various aspects of their assigned department, including generation and monitoring of reports, letters, evaluation, and scheduling and conducting required coaching with team members.

REQUIREMENTS

Job Knowledge and Skill

  • Bachelor's degree in business or related field, and 3-5 years of supervisory role preferred, OR proven experience demonstrating:
    • Ability to review and interpret key performance indicators
    • Ability to establish and manage to operational performance goals
    • Ability to identify and resolve operational roadblocks
    • Ability to anticipate short term and long-term problems and implement solutions
    • Ability to be flexible and adaptable to change
    • Ability to influence employee satisfaction
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and oral
  • Strong organization and time management skills
  • Extensive knowledge and understanding auto auction operations
  • General understanding of vehicle repossession and title processing
  • Proficiency with Microsoft productivity tools (Excel, 365, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, Visio)
  • Personal attributes: Commitment / Dependability, Even Temperament, Integrity, Attention to Detail, Problem Solving
  • Talented negotiator and manage to make deals that are not only profitable but a broad experience for both negotiating parties
  • Business Acumen - Understands business implications of decisions; Demonstrates knowledge of market and competition.

The US salary range for this full-time position is $ 80,000 - $ 124,000

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects a national minimum and maximum range for new hire salaries for this position.

Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range that meets your criteria during the hiring process.

Please note that the compensation range listed in this posting reflects only the base salary for this position and does not include other compensation elements or benefits.

raw.description:
Why Us

NewRocket is the AI-first Elite ServiceNow Partner that activates real value on the Now Platform. As a trusted advisor to enterprise leaders, we combine industry expertise, human-centered design, and enterprise-grade AI to help organizations navigate change and scale with confidence. With two decades of experience guiding clients to realize the full potential of the ServiceNow AI Platform, we are one of the largest pure-play ServiceNow partners, uniquely focused on enabling enterprises to adopt AI they trust—AI that delivers lasting business value.

We #GoBeyondWorkflows to create new kinds of experiences for our customers.

Come join our Crew!

The Role

NewRocket is a global team made up of ServiceNow professionals who help our customers run and grow their ServiceNow environments. We are hiring a ServiceNow Senior Software Engineer with Service Portal/HRSD experience. The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for leading, coaching and mentoring a team of Software Engineers who provide the development of project professional services for customers. The Senior Software Engineer will implement and develop customizations based on functional and technical requirements using leading practices and internal code standards on large-scale more complex professional services projects.

We will provide support and guidance to get you up to speed on some of the most amazing projects! We provide official ServiceNow training so you can achieve multiple certifications. We will set expectations for what success looks like. Then we will allow you use your skills and experience to come up with innovative solutions to achieve customer goals.

We are #GoingBeyond Come join our crew!

What You Will Be Doing

  • As a Senior Software Engineer, you will interface with end-users, key stakeholders to gather systems requirements for Service Portal/HRSD
  • You will customize ServiceNow applications and support the rollout of new features and modules, including configuration of application UI, workflows, and business logic
  • Configuring integrations between ServiceNow via REST/SOAP web and other applications
  • Strong experience with ITSM, Service Portal & B2B Integrations and can guide customers through understanding technical solutions to their business requirements
  • Interact with technical SMEs to get necessary environment information to support your service map and event work
  • Reflect impact assessment rules within service maps and validate with technical SMEs and stakeholders
  • Participate in user acceptance testing of the resulting maps, impact rules and event management work
  • Promote your update sets and data across applicable SN environments
  • Remediate any production incidents that arise related to this scope
  • Align with existing SN technical lead for map/event work to ensure consistent approach that does not break shared patterns
  • Proactively maintain operational documentation and SOPs to reduce support risk & inefficiency

What You Bring Along

  • 4+ years’ experience supporting the implementation, administration, configuration, and/or development of ServiceNow in 2 or more capabilities (ITSM/Service Portal/HRSD, B2B Integrations, etc.)
  • Strong Experience in Service Portal / HRSD
  • Experience with integration between ServiceNow and other systems/platforms using both mid servers and cloud to cloud
  • Experience working with Web Services Integration (SOAP, REST) and any bi-directional, automated integration between two systems.
  • Data Extraction Technologies (e.g. JDBC, ODBC) or ETL integrations
  • Proven experience with implementing ServiceNow ITSM, Service Catalog, and Workflows to meet business requirements
  • Experience in all aspects of ServiceNow scripting including Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Builder, Scripted REST APIs, and Script Includes
  • Ability to create technical design documents and user documentation

Education:

  • A four-year undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems or demonstrated work experience

Certifications & Knowledge

The candidate must be willing and able to continue their education within the ServiceNow platform and beyond. It is expected that the candidate will be able to complete ServiceNow competency Certifications as well as Module Accreditations.

Preferred Certifications:

  • ITIL Foundation
  • ServiceNow CSA and CAD

We Take Care of Our People

NewRocket is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We value and celebrate diversity, believing that every employee matters and should be respected and heard.  We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer, committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin, or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, citizenship, military, or Veteran status. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please contact hr.in@newrocket.com.

Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and succeed in the AI-driven content era. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

Marketers get a visual editor with reusable components, in-context preview, and workflows to launch fast and stay on brand. Developers have freedom to use their favorite frameworks and integrate with anything through the API-first platform. Brands get one source of truth for content that is accurate, flexible, and measurable.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact. It’s Joyful Headless™, and it changes everything.

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

  • Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)
  • Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding
  • Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays
  • Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material
  • VSOP (Virtual Stock Option Plan)
  • The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers
  • As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules
  • An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

JOB SUMMARY

The Manager of Solution Engineering leads a team of Solution Engineers who partner with Sales to demonstrate the technical value of Storyblok's headless CMS platform to prospective customers. This role owns the technical strategy for the sales cycle, from discovery through solution design and technical close, while coaching the team to consistently connect capabilities to customer value. The Manager also bridges Sales, Product, and Engineering, ensuring customer feedback shapes the roadmap. Success means a high-performing SE team that accelerates deal velocity and builds lasting trust with customers.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Solution Engineers to deliver high-impact technical demos and discovery
  • Partner with Sales leadership to align SE resources with pipeline priorities and deal strategy
  • Own technical win strategy across the sales cycle, from discovery through technical close
  • Coach the team to connect Storyblok's capabilities directly to customer business value
  • Act as the voice of the customer to Product and Engineering, feeding field insights into the roadmap
  • Recruit, hire, and onboard new Solution Engineers
  • Define and track team performance metrics (e.g., win rates, deal velocity, technical CSAT)
  • Develop and maintain SE enablement content, demo environments, and best practices

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Required: prior experience as a Solution Engineering Manager
  • Required: experience with SaaS products, ideally in a technical pre-sales capacity
  • Preferred: experience with CMS, DXP, or web/content management platforms
  • Preferred: background as an individual-contributor Solution Engineer, Sales Engineer, or similar customer-facing role prior to management
  • Preferred: familiarity with modern web development concepts (APIs, JavaScript frameworks, headless architecture)
  • Preferred: experience selling into enterprise or mid-market buyers
  • Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

U.S. Base Salary Range: $145,900 - $200,000

Senior Contract Administrator/Paralegal

(Franchise)

Engel & Völkers is a global luxury brand specializing in residential and commercial real estate, drawing on its rich European heritage to deliver a fresh approach to luxury real estate in the Americas. Engel & Völkers Americas, Inc. supports a franchise network of premium residential real estate brokerages throughout the United States, Canada, Mexico, the Caribbean, and Central America, operating approximately 300 shop locations with approximately 6,000 affiliated real estate professionals and is responsible for the brand’s ongoing expansion in additional markets in the Americas.

Engel & Völkers Americas, Inc. is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Senior Contract Administrator/Paralegal to join our growing legal team located in New York City. This position provides a great opportunity to support all relevant legal aspects needed for the franchise lifecycle contract management, compliance, and litigation. The ideal candidate has a “can do'' attitude and vivid interest in collaborating on a variety of legal matters in a service and growth focused company. We are a team of professionals passionate about our brand and are looking for a team player who shares the same values. This role offers flexibility to work remotely.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assist with preparing, reviewing, and management of franchise agreements, renewals, and amendments.
  • Manage the full contract lifecycle, including organization, tracking, and timely execution of franchise and business contracts.
  • Assist with state and federal franchise registrations and renewals, including Franchise Disclosure Documents (FDDs).
  • Support monitoring franchisee compliance matters and draft related notices (default, termination, and other compliance communications).
  • Partner cross-functionally to address contract-related questions and resolve issues efficiently.
  • Track key deadlines and ensure proactive follow-up.
  • Help refine and strengthen contract management policies, procedures, and systems.
  • Organize and maintain a comprehensive contract management system.
  • Prepare summaries and internal memoranda as requested by the legal team.
  • Support franchise disputes, mediation, or litigation matters in collaboration with the legal team.
  • Assist with corporate filings, resolutions, and governance documentation.
  • Provide administrative and operational support to the legal team, including scheduling and coordination.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree required; paralegal certification preferred.
  • 7+ years of relevant experience, ideally with exposure to franchise law.

SKILLS

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and analytically strong
  • Business savvy and confident under pressure.
  • Proactive, solution-oriented, and comfortable in a fast-paced, “make it happen” culture
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize multiple competing tasks and demands, proactively seek supervisory guidance when appropriate, and consistently maintain high quality standards without compromising attention to detail
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Suite.
  • Experience with DocuSign, HubSpot, and LinkSquares CLM is preferred, but not required.

Do you feel that you are the right individual to accept and succeed in this position? We are looking forward to receiving your application.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants. We consider candidates for all positions without regard to race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, sex, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

About Us

Ylopo, LLC is a rapidly growing marketing and technology company providing internet marketing services and proprietary lead generation and engagement software to successful real estate agents across the country. We are seeking an outgoing, tech savvy individual to join our growing team.

Why work for Ylopo?

At Ylopo we offer team members:

  • a commitment to personal development,

  • guidance and support at a high level through interfacing with our Executive Team to prioritize goals as a company,

  • excellent leadership and mentoring for our entry-level to senior staff, and recognition of outstanding efforts,

  • team building events, team lunches/ happy hours, and other company wide events

  • a supportive, caring environment dedicated to continuous learning and growth.

Ylopo Account Executive Job Description

Ylopo is looking for our next superstar Account Executive. We are entering our next phase of growth and building a dynamic outbound team made up of high energy Account Executives.

You'll love this role if... you are a natural born seller who yearns to be in a true team atmosphere where a driven individual can grow to unlimited heights in one of the largest and fastest growing industries in the world.

Who We Are:

Founded by two real estate technology veterans, Ylopo has developed a next generation Complete Digital Marketing and Technology Platform that generates and nurtures high quality home-buyers and sellers for its client base of real estate agents, teams, and brokerages.

There are almost 2 million real estate professionals in the U.S. who are prime prospects for our suite of superior products including a proprietary technology that sits on top of Facebook unleashing the most targeted and cost effective lead generation opportunity the real estate industry has ever seen.

Ylopo is now entering a very exciting and high-growth stage and we’re looking to add more great people to our driven, fun, and close-knit staff. Ylopo is an ideal place to work for anyone who wants to be in a growing industry, winning atmosphere, with the ability to be autonomous and develop professionally.

Account Executives Key Responsibilities:

  • Identify and pursue potential Ylopo customers
  • Schedule and hold engaging sales demos.
  • Negotiate and present powerful business cases to close new clients.
  • Earn client’s trust by understanding their needs and thoughtfully answering their questions.
  • Demonstrate how our technology platform works and how it can help the client’s business grow.
  • Implement and follow structured sales and account management processes including tracking key data in our CRM platform.
  • Achieve performance metrics and goals set by management.

Required Qualifications:

  • At least 3+ years of work experience in either B2B software sales or the real estate industry
  • Fluency in using online CRM platforms
  • Track record of high achievement - tell us what you've done that makes you a winner!
  • Integrity, energy, and genuine desire to understand and solve customer problems
  • Ability to think on your feet
  • Comfortable with selling over the phone
  • Confident, competitive, high level work ethic, sense of urgency, and a closer mentality
  • Ability to prioritize and handle time effectively
  • Strong listening and presentation skills
  • Excellent written/verbal communication skills
  • Four-year college degree is preferred but not required

What we offer:

  • $60,000+ guaranteed base salary with the potential to earn over $125,000 to $150,000 per year with a target-based sales commission plan.
  • Benefits package includes health coverage, paid vacation/sick days, and a retirement savings plan

Ylopo is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against applicants based on race, religion, color, disability, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity or expression, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), age, veteran status or other legally protected characteristics. We are committed to fostering, cultivating and preserving a culture of diversity, equity and inclusion. To learn more about this commitment, visit: www.ylopo.com/ylopos-diversity-equity-and-inclusion-policy

About us:

Grail Talent is an Influencer Management Agency that connects our diverse and carefully curated roster of content creators with digital marketing opportunities, working with brands and record labels to advertise products and music on social media through influencer promotion and performance marketing.

We work with some of the biggest players in Music and New Media, including Sony Music Entertainment and Amazon Prime Video, to help promote the next viral sensation or hit show. raw.description:
CWS seeks an experienced Systems/Network Administrator Lead to lead enterprise systems and network administration supporting the U.S. Military Entrance Processing Command (USMEPCOM) Enterprise Network for Lifecycle, Information Support, and Technology (ENLIST) program. 

The Systems/Network Administrator Lead will be responsible for systems and network administration, operations and maintenance (O&M), and associated activities supporting platforms installed throughout the USMEPCOM enterprise. This individual will serve as the contractor's service owner for enterprise infrastructure services, ensuring systems consistently meet defined service levels while providing secure, reliable, and highly available operations. 

The Systems/Network Administrator Lead will provide technical leadership for enterprise servers, operating systems, databases, virtualization platforms, storage, collaboration technologies, cloud environments, and network infrastructure.

This position will also lead the Outage Response Team (ORT), directing enterprise outage response, disaster recovery, Continuity of Operations (COOP), incident management, and restoration efforts while serving as the primary technical point of contact during major incidents. 

Working closely with Government leadership, engineering teams, cybersecurity personnel, vendors, and external partners, the Systems/Network Administrator Lead will ensure enterprise infrastructure remains secure, compliant, resilient, interoperable, and mission-ready. 

The successful candidate will possess exceptional technical leadership skills, extensive enterprise infrastructure experience, and the ability to lead geographically dispersed technical teams supporting a complex Department of Defense IT enterprise. 

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

    • Lead enterprise systems administration, network operations, and operations and maintenance (O&M) activities across the USMEPCOM enterprise. 

    • Serve as the contractor's service owner for enterprise infrastructure services and ensure systems consistently meet defined service level objectives. 

    • Plan, organize, and direct contractor personnel responsible for operations and maintenance of USMEPCOM-constructed networks. 

    • Provide technical leadership for Windows and UNIX/Linux operating systems, physical and virtual servers, databases, VMware ESXi environments, Storage Area Networks (SANs), collaboration tools, enterprise applications, and cloud infrastructure. 

    • Perform system-level configuration, validation, integration, and administration of enterprise hardware, software, operating systems, and infrastructure platforms while maintaining interoperability with existing legacy systems. 

    • Lead engineering development, infrastructure integration, interface design analysis, software and hardware testing, and enterprise systems implementation activities. 

    • Apply Risk Management Framework (RMF) security principles, practices, and procedures to maintain compliance with Department of Defense cybersecurity requirements. 

    • Lead the Outage Response Team (ORT) and direct all activities associated with enterprise outage response, incident management, disaster recovery, and Continuity of Operations (COOP). 

    • Serve as the primary point of contact during enterprise outages, coordinating response activities with Government leadership, vendors, DISA, external agencies, and other stakeholders. 

    • Coordinate, direct, and oversee outage resolution efforts while providing timely status updates to Government leadership throughout incident response activities. 

    • Develop, maintain, and regularly update enterprise outage response procedures, Incident Response Plans, disaster recovery documentation, and operational playbooks. 

    • Review Incident Response Plans quarterly to ensure system inventories, procedures, documentation, and operational processes remain current. 

    • Lead geographically dispersed teams responsible for enterprise infrastructure operations, systems administration, and network support. 

    • Monitor enterprise performance, availability, and operational health while proactively identifying opportunities for infrastructure improvements, automation, and operational efficiencies. 

    • Support cloud technologies, virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI), enterprise networking, firewall administration, secure communications, and enterprise modernization initiatives. 

    • Foster continuous improvement while ensuring compliance with Federal Government, Department of Defense, and enterprise IT operational standards and best practices. 

Education & Experience

    • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, or a related technical discipline is preferred. 

    • Minimum five (5) years recent experience managing enterprise IT teams in geographically dispersed locations supporting operations and maintenance of enterprise servers (physical and virtual), operating systems (Windows and UNIX/Linux), databases, VMware ESXi, Storage Area Networks (SANs), collaboration tools, enterprise applications, scripting, and enterprise security. 

    • Minimum one (1) year recent experience:

    • Leading network personnel and coordinating enterprise outage response procedures

    • Supporting DISA network transport solutions.

    • Minimum five (5) years recent experience supporting:

    • Cloud-based enterprise solutions and cloud infrastructure

    • Virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI) environments

    • In enterprise network and systems administration, including outage response and incident management

    • Leading enterprise network operations teams supporting programs similar in size, scope, and complexity to this Task Order

    • Minimum six (6) years recent experience supporting global enterprise network systems and subsystems, including LAN, WAN, MPLS, BGP, network availability, troubleshooting, and infrastructure optimization

    • Minimum three (3) years experience:

    • Supporting IPv4 and IPv6 protocol stacks

    • Planning and executing local and long-haul communications 

    • Supporting and troubleshooting firewall appliances, firewall rulesets, and enterprise firewall solutions

Certifications

    Must have or obtain all certifications required under DoDM 8140.03 Cyberspace Workforce Qualification and Management Program.

    • Must have an active ITIL® 4 Practice Manager Certification or ITIL® 4 Foundation Certification.

    • Candidates who do not currently possess the following certifications must obtain them within one month of hire. The company will sponsor certification training and examination costs as needed.

    • Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE) certification.

    • Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE) or Cisco Certified Design Expert (CCDE) certification.

    • At least one information security certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)).

    • At least two network certifications (e.g., Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), CompTIA Network+).

    • DoDI 8570.01 Information Assurance System Architect and Engineer (IASAE) Level III certification.

Security Clearance

  • Active Secret Clearance is required.

Other (Travel, Work Environment, DoD 8570 Requirements, Administrative Notes, etc.)

  • This position is primarily remote. Candidates located in the Chicago area are preferred, but this is not a requirement. Approximately 25% travel is anticipated during the first six months of the contract, primarily to the USMEPCOM Headquarters in North Chicago, Illinois, to support transition activities and program ramp-up. Once the program is fully operational, travel is expected to decrease to approximately 10% for periodic customer meetings and program support.

IDEXX software brings together everything from appointment scheduling and preparation to all aspects of a clinical visit, including diagnostics and pet owner communications.

So, what does that mean for you? We enrich the livelihoods of our employees with a positive and respectful work culture that embraces challenges and encourages learning and discovery. Let’s pursue what matters together.

raw.excerpt: About NOCD NOCD is an award-winning digital health company focused on identifying people with obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) and managing them using evidence-based treatment.
raw.description:
About NOCD

NOCD is an award-winning digital health company focused on identifying people with obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) and managing them using evidence-based treatment. OCD affects over 181 million people globally and is ranked by the World Health Organization as one of the top 10 most disabling conditions. Despite this, over 90% of people with OCD are unable to access effective care due to stigma and misdiagnosis—earning it the nickname “the secret illness.”

NOCD is solving this global problem by identifying OCD patients online and managing them using our evidence-based OCD treatment platform. Members can access licensed mental health professionals with specialized training in OCD, receive video-based teletherapy, and engage with tech-enabled tools and moderated communities for continuous support.

Today, NOCD manages the largest community of OCD patients in the world—and we’re just getting started.

About the Role

This is not a traditional, transactional customer service or call center role. As a Member Advocate (Intake Specialist), you are the critical bridge between a person suffering in silence with OCD and the life-changing evidence-based Exposure and Response Prevention (ERP) therapy they desperately need.

When a potential member calls NOCD, they aren't just looking to schedule an appointment—they are often sharing their deepest anxieties, fears, and vulnerabilities with you. Your job is to sit in empathy with them, deeply listen to their experience, and build instant trust. At the same time, you are an advocate who must confidently navigate their hesitations, handle complex objections, and guide them to make a life-changing commitment: scheduling their first therapy session before the call ends.

This role requires a rare combination of exceptional emotional intelligence and a goal-oriented, consultative sales mindset. You will be held to clear key performance indicators (KPIs) centered on enrollment conversion rates, because every conversion represents a life saved from OCD.

What You’ll Do (Responsibilities):

  • Conduct Elevated Consultative Intake Conversations: Make outbound calls to individuals seeking help, guiding them from a place of vulnerability to a place of action.
  • Empathic Deep Listening & Value Messaging: Listen to highly sensitive accounts of OCD symptoms with an empathetic ear, and clearly articulate how NOCD’s specialized ERP therapy can help them regain control of their lives.
  • Navigate Complex Objections: Confidently address common barriers to care (e.g., financial concerns, scheduling hesitations, fear of starting therapy) using advanced objection-handling techniques to keep the member moving forward.
  • Drive Enrollment Conversions: Own the entire initial relationship with the goal of connecting the member to care and scheduling their first session by the end of the initial contact.
  • Implement Feedback: Openly receive and rapidly implement regular coaching from leadership regarding call quality, metric tracking, and conversational delivery.

Who Thrives Here (Preferred Backgrounds): We find that the professionals who excel in this role don't come from high-volume, resolution-focued customer service. Instead, they usually have a unique blend of human-centric interviewing and goal-driven conversion experience. You will be a strong fit if you have a background in:

  • Intake / Investigative Interviewing: Experience handling highly sensitive client stories while needing to qualify and "close" the client for the firm.
  • Crisis Hotlines / Peer Support Specialist / Treatment Coordinator: Deeply trained in active listening, de-escalation, and holding space for raw human emotion, combined with a desire to work in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.
  • Consultative Inside Sales / Admissions: Experience in high-consideration sales (like higher education admissions or medical counseling) where your success relies entirely on building deep trust and overcoming heavy emotional or financial objections.

Minimum Requirements:

  • 1–3 years of experience in a consultative sales, enrollment, or high-stakes intake environment where you were measured against performance metrics/KPIs.
  • Exceptional emotional stamina and the ability to pivot seamlessly from a deeply empathetic emotional conversation to a structured enrollment close.
  • Superb communication skills—able to speak about complex mental health topics with authority, clarity, and warmth.
  • Technologically nimble; able to manage multiple software platforms, scheduling systems, and communication channels simultaneously in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • High School Diploma or GED required; Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Social Work, Communications, or a related field is strongly preferred.

Why Work for NOCD

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. With an inclusive culture and ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life. At NOCD, you will:

  • Help scale one of the fastest-growing specialty behavioral health organizations in the world.
  • Work directly with operational, clinical, product, and business leaders to solve meaningful challenges at scale.
  • Use data, technology, and critical thinking to drive measurable improvements in member outcomes and business performance.
  • Contribute to a mission that helps people reclaim their lives from one of the world's most disabling mental health conditions.
  • Build your career in a high-growth environment where ownership, innovation, and execution are valued and rewarded.
  • Play a role in shaping the future of NOCD as we expand beyond OCD into additional behavioral health specialties.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, NOCD is the place for you.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package, including Medical, Dental, Vision, and a 401K plan with a Company Match.
  • Employee Assistance Programs, including Mental Health, Wellness, Financial, Legal, and Pet Insurance
  • Generous PTO policy with 11 observed company holidays
  • 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for the primary caregiver, and 6 weeks of fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver, for qualifying full-time employees.

Current Shift Options

  • Off Tues/Wed
    • 1:30-10 PM CT weekdays
    • 10:30 AM - 7 PM CT weekends
  • Off Wed/Thurs
    • 1:30-10 PM CT weekdays
    • 10:30 AM - 7 PM CT weekends

Laptop and Equipment will be provided. Compensation for this role is $50,000.
