Flow Production Tracking Administrator (6 month CONTRACT)

United States, Remote

Insomniac Games is looking for a Flow Production Tracking Administrator. In this role, the Flow Administrator is responsible for stabilizing and maintaining our Flow Production Tracking (formerly ShotGrid) environment, with an initial focus on the Flow/Jira Bridge that underpins our daily production workflow. Flow is the system of record for production tracking across 300+ users and thousands of tasks per month. The initial scope of the engagement is 6 months, prioritizing bridge stability before expanding to broader Flow improvements.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Stands up a studio-owned instance of the Flow/Jira Bridge so that bridge configuration, deployment, and recovery can be managed internally without dependency on Sony Interactive Entertainment HQ.
  • Stabilizes and maintains the Flow/Jira Bridge as the first priority of the engagement, ensuring data integrity between Flow and Jira.
  • Re-architects the Flow automation and event listener layer for reliability and security, including migration off the current virtual machine to infrastructure that is not prone to unscheduled restarts.
  • Troubleshoots Flow and Jira Bridge issues for internal developers and external development partners; serves as the primary point of escalation when the system is not behaving.
  • Audits and documents the current Flow and Jira Bridge configuration, integration architecture, and recovery procedures.
  • Fixes broken or degraded areas of the Flow pipeline as scoped with pipeline engineering, beginning with the Character workflow.
  • Sets up and improves Flow pipelines for upcoming work, including VFX, and contributes ongoing improvements to the Cinematics pipeline.
  • Administers Flow Production Tracking day-to-day: schema, permissions, page layouts, custom fields, entity relationships, and project setup.
  • Configures and supports vendor (external partner) permissions and workflows, ensuring information access is appropriate to each partnership.
  • Designs and builds Flow dashboards, reports, and custom pages to meet production and leadership reporting needs.
  • Other duties may be assigned.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION

  • Five plus years of professional experience administering Flow Production Tracking, ShotGrid, or Shotgun in a games, VFX, or animation production environment, or an equivalent amount of education and experience.
  • Demonstrated experience operating in a multi-vendor co-development environment.
  • Shipped at least one AAA title with Flow/ShotGrid as the production system of record preferred.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

  • Hands-on experience with the sg-jira-bridge or a comparable Flow/Jira integration, including reading, modifying, and deploying the Python service independently.
  • Working knowledge of the Flow Python API and Toolkit (tk-core, pipeline configurations, YAML configuration).
  • Experience deploying and operating the Flow event listener and automation framework as a reliable service rather than as a fragile script on a virtual machine.
  • Proficiency with Jira administration, including workflows, custom fields, issue types, and the Jira REST API.
  • Comfort designing permissions and information access for mixed internal and external (vendor) user populations.
  • Familiarity with Perforce, Maya, and standard DCC pipelines.
  • Experience with self-hosted services, containerization, or CI/CD for pipeline tooling is a plus.
  • Experience with RV, Deadline, or other render/review tool integrations is a plus.
  • SQL and reporting or BI tool experience is a plus.

OTHER SKILLS

  • Strong written communication; able to produce documentation that others can use to operate and recover the system.
  • Ability to triage between time-sensitive production issues and longer-term platform work without losing momentum on either.
  • High degree of autonomy and accountability; proactively identifies and resolves production issues without requiring close oversight.
  • Collaborative and solutions-oriented mindset with a track record of building strong working relationships with internal teams and external partners.
  • Ability to work effectively across time zones with overseas external development partners.

Please note that the individual base pay range may vary based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

In addition, this role is eligible for benefit offerings that include medical, dental, and vision. Click here to learn more.

$84—$84 USD

As an Associate Data Platform Engineering Manager reporting to the Head of Data Engineering in our Data & Analytics - Data Platform Engineering team, your purpose will be to lead a small, high-impact team of 2-3 platform engineers while staying heavily involved in hands-on technical work.

You’ll split your time between people leadership - coaching your team, driving agile delivery, and managing OKRs - and engineering tasks. You will design reliable Terraform/Terragrunt modules on GCP, champion data security controls (Dataplex, DLP), and establish standard, self-service developer tools that empower our downstream data teams to build with confidence.

Requirements

Essentially, to ensure you succeed in this role you’re going to need…

  • Dual Track Experience: 5+ years of experience in data platform, infrastructure, or DevOps engineering, with initial experience leading, mentoring, or managing tech teams.
  • Strong Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Deep, practical experience using Terraform/Terragrunt to architect and manage infrastructure, preferably on Google Cloud Platform.
  • Advanced Platform Skillset: Strong familiarity with GCP data services (BigQuery, Cloud Composer, GKE, IAM) and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Platform-as-a-Product Mindset: A strong focus on customer enablement, platform reliability, system governance, and security.
  • English Fluency: At a minimum, we require professional English language skills (B2 level or higher). Why? English is our company language and is used for any business-wide communications, so we need you to be able to communicate smoothly to feel like an integrated part of Booksy.

It will also help you to have…

  • Modern Open-Source Tools: An open-source-first mindset when researching, evaluating, or building internal platform tools.
  • Next-Gen Architectures: Exposure to PySpark and open table formats (Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake).
  • AI Integration: Experience or strong interest in applying AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude) and monitoring LLM-driven pipelines.

Benefits

Some of the benefits we offer are:

  • We're proudly distributed across the globe, with each market being remote-first. Depending on which market you're joining, you might have office access or be fully remote - either works. All we ask is that you're based in the country/region this role is advertised in.
  • Additional benefits that might differ depending on the location. You shall be provided with the benefits details during or after your first conversation with one of our TA Specialists.
  • Work in a welcoming team which is always ready to help.
  • Opportunity to develop in an international environment - we have teams in 6 countries.


How AI helps us find great people

Think of our AI tool as a really smart assistant for our recruitment team. Its job? To help us move faster, stay consistent, and make sure no great candidates are overlooked. Every application goes through the same AI review to help us spot skills that match the role - but don’t worry, AI never makes the decisions. Real people do. Our recruiters and hiring managers handle every final call. And we regularly review how the tool is used to keep things fair, ethical, and compliant with data protection laws. Curious about how it works? You can always ask how AI was used in your application - it won’t affect your chances in any way.

If you have questions, just drop us a note - we’re happy to explain more.

Our Diversity and Inclusion Commitment:

We work in a highly creative and diverse industry so it goes without saying that we strive to create an inclusive environment for all. We welcome people from all backgrounds and are committed to fair consideration in our hiring process. If you have any accessibility needs or require reasonable adjustments during the interview process, please contact us at belonging@booksy.com, so we can best support you.

Kindly submit your application and CV in English to ensure it is successfully reviewed.

DIRECTOR, CLIENT E-COMMERCE AND DIGITAL STRATEGY

JOB SUMMARY

The Director, Client eCommerce and Digital Strategy is responsible for developing and implementing marketing strategies that exceed client goals, including revenue and occupancy objectives. This role manages multiple client contracts requiring the development and execution of brand strategies, creation of marketing roadmaps, and implementation of day-to-day performance across client digital marketing channels.

Working collaboratively with clients and cross-functional internal teams, the Director leads digital marketing and ecommerce initiatives that drive measurable business outcomes. Success in this role is measured through client satisfaction, delivery of innovative marketing programs, contribution to team member development, accountability for revenue performance, and impact on financial results and new business development.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Strategic digital marketing and ecommerce professional with strong client relationship management skills
  • Results-oriented marketer focused on driving measurable revenue, occupancy, and performance outcomes
  • Collaborative partner who works effectively across cross-functional teams and disciplines
  • Strong communicator able to translate digital marketing performance, strategy, and insights into actionable recommendations
  • Forward-thinking marketer who understands how emerging platforms, AI-powered search, and evolving traveler behaviors influence digital discovery and conversion
  • Organized and adaptable leader comfortable managing multiple client engagements, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the development of annual services, statements of work, and annual digital marketing plans in partnership with client marketing, operations, and revenue teams to support ecommerce growth and execution through Miles Partnership
  • Manage day-to-day client relationships and communicate regularly on the performance of ecommerce and digital marketing strategies
  • Evaluate brand positioning for clients and facilitate marketing research to identify opportunities to strengthen messaging, design, and alignment with target audiences
  • Develop and execute ecommerce campaigns designed to increase awareness and revenue across channels including SEO, SEM, paid social media, online digital advertising, online travel agencies (OTAs), social commerce, affiliate marketing, influencer/creator marketing, content marketing, and third-party online listings
  • Lead, collaborate with, and mentor cross-functional teams including Media, Web Development, Content and SEO, Design, Analytics, and Research to plan, execute, and optimize acquisition and conversion efforts
  • Ensure promotion and distribution of rate offers, packages, and programs are tracking against planned performance; provide recommendations for optimization and funding allocation as needed
  • Research, analyze, and monitor financial, technological, and demographic trends to identify market opportunities and minimize competitive impacts
  • Identify new revenue opportunities for clients beyond current distribution strategies, including affiliate partnerships, social commerce platforms, and influencer/creator-driven revenue channels
  • Provide subject matter expertise and recommendations related to emerging trends and capabilities including attribution, programmatic media buying, digital media platforms, AI-powered search, and large language models (LLMs) such as Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity and their impact on hotel discovery and booking intent
  • Support consistent execution of client brand standards across digital marketing channels and campaigns
  • Act as an internal consultant on ad hoc projects and develop presentations for a variety of topics and audiences
  • Represent Miles Partnership and client accounts at client meetings, industry events, and stakeholder meetings
  • Oversee day-to-day deliverables in collaboration with clients and ensure contractual requirements are consistently met across engagements
  • Contribute to client retention, account growth, and new business development through strategic leadership and relationship management
  • Travel to build relationships with stakeholders within client industries and identify opportunities for growth with existing and prospective clients

REQUIREMENTS

  • 5+ years of directly related ecommerce and digital marketing/advertising experience, including experience managing digital media planning, negotiation, execution, and performance measurement
  • 5+ years working directly with Revenue Management teams to drive web-direct bookings, interpret forecasts, and apply rstrategies to maximize performance
  • Experience managing budgets exceeding $500,000 tied directly to revenue performance and client value delivery
  • Strong understanding of hospitality ecommerce tactics and digital marketing channels, including SEO/SEM, paid social, programmatic media, OTAs, email marketing, meta-search, affiliate marketing, influencer/creator marketing, social commerce, and content marketing
  • Experience managing digital media vendors, attribution frameworks, and performance measurement strategies tied to ecommerce outcomes
  • Working knowledge of analytics, attribution, and performance measurement platforms, including an understanding of how AI-powered search tools and large language models (LLMs) are influencing travel discovery, booking intent, and brand visibility
  • Strong communication, leadership, and collaboration skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, work effectively under deadlines, and respond constructively to feedback
  • Frequent intra- and inter-state travel required (approximately 25–35% of time), including occasional overnight stays.

About Miles Partnership

Miles Partnership is a strategic marketing consultancy focused exclusively on travel and tourism. Our team of travel experts and travel enthusiasts are united in the belief that travel enriches lives and strengthens communities. We work with destinations, hospitality businesses and other travel industry clients worldwide to develop marketing and management strategies that amplify local experiences, boost visitation, improve community relations and increase overall economic impact.

About the Miles Partnership, LLLP Portfolio of Brands

Miles Partnership is part of Miles Partnership, LLLP—a global collective of specialized brands united by a shared commitment to advancing the travel industry through collaboration, innovation and meaningful impact. With more than 400 employees across the U.S. and internationally, our portfolio of companies serves 250+ clients worldwide, including destination marketing organizations, state and national tourism offices, hospitality brands, attractions, airports, economic development organizations and mission-driven nonprofits. Together, we deliver the full range of marketing, media, public relations, content, research and strategic consulting services the travel industry depends on.

OUR COMMITMENT TO CULTURE:

At Miles Partnership, we are driven by our commitment to actively evolve inclusive marketing industry practices, drive innovation within the company and empower our team, our clients and the communities we serve. We will make intentional actions to build a work culture where our team members are always heard, empowered and valued. We will provide a culture of service where we enable our teams and clients to meaningfully engage with their communities, share and tell their stories through travel, and lead a movement across the broader tourism industry to influence social change and ensure open access to travel for all.

raw.description:
We're not looking for someone who has "used CoPilot." We're looking for a Senior Java Backend & DevOps Engineer who already runs agentic workflows as a core part of how they ship – multiple Claude Code / Codex / Cursor agents in parallel, custom subagents, MCP servers, skills, planning loops, review gates – and who has opinions about which patterns actually work in production versus which ones look good in demos.

You'll bring that practice to backend systems that keep entire game worlds alive for millions of players. Always-on, low-latency, unpredictable load. Real player impact when something is off by 20 ms.

In this role you'll join Goodgame Studios – self-published MMO strategy titles, 200M+ registered players, €1B+ in lifetime revenue, part of Stillfront Group, one of Europe's leading game publishers.

THE ROLE

You own backend services end-to-end: architecture, implementation, infrastructure, deployment, production, scaling. The difference from a traditional senior role is leverage – you're expected to operate at 10–20× the throughput of a classical engineer by orchestrating agents rather than typing every line yourself. You stay the architect and the reviewer. The agents do the volume.

YOUR MISSION

  • Design and operate high-throughput, low-latency Java services (JDK 17+) on AWS, K8s, Terraform, ArgoCD.

  • Build resilient distributed components and tune memory, concurrency, and GC for real production workloads.

  • Architect MySQL and Redis layers handling millions of player rows.

  • Own CI/CD, observability, and on-call for systems you ship.

  • Run an agentic workflow that holds up under code review: precise specs, tight feedback loops, generated tests, validation gates, your judgement as the final filter on architecture, security, and performance.

  • Help define how the rest of the engineering org adopts agentic practices – tooling, review standards, what "done" means when an agent wrote 80% of the diff.

YOUR PROFILE

  • 6+ years backend Java, expert level. Distributed systems, concurrency, GC tuning, SQL optimisation are second nature.

  • Deep AWS and cloud-native stack (K8s, Docker, Terraform).

  • A real agentic coding practice. You can talk concretely about: how you structure prompts and context for long-running tasks, when you let an agent run autonomously vs. when you intervene, how you manage multi-agent setups, what you've built with MCP / custom tools / skills, and how you review agent-generated code without becoming a bottleneck.

  • Strong analytical decomposition – the ability to turn fuzzy product asks into precise constraints both humans and agents can execute against.

  • Architectural judgement. You design clean, resilient systems; you don't just accept whatever the agent produces.

  • Highly proficient in English.

  • Seeking full-time remote roles (within Germany, valid German visa required) or Freelance opportunities within the German timezone (CET/CEST).

Nice to have

  • Gaming backend experience (matchmaking, inventories, leaderboards, economy services).

  • Event-driven architectures (Kafka, Kinesis, SQS/SNS).

  • Real-time telemetry or anti-cheat systems.

  • Published or shared work on agentic workflows – blog posts, OSS subagents/skills, internal tooling you've open-sourced.

HOW WE WILL INTERVIEW

Expect to walk us through an agentic workflow you've actually built and used – the specs and context you feed it, how you structure the loop, where it breaks, how you catch it, and what you'd never let an agent do unsupervised. Bring screen-shares, repos, prompts, whatever shows the real thing. We're more interested in your judgement and battle scars than in polished slides.

WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

  • You'll work on systems players interact with every minute, at a scale where engineering decisions show up immediately in metrics.

  • You'll help set the bar for what agentic engineering looks like in a 30+ person backend org that ships real products – not a lab, not a pilot.

  • High autonomy. Remote within the German time zone. Engineering-first culture.

  • Genuinely interesting technical surface area: Java, MySQL, Redis, AWS, distributed systems, plus the meta-problem of how to run all of it agentically without sacrificing reliability.

Collaborate closely with our 30+ dedicated professionals at Goodgame Studios, employ your initiative and strong communication skills to seamlessly integrate your ideas into our MMO pioneer games with more than 200 million registered players worldwide and a history of more than 1bn € in revenues. If you're ready to take on this challenge and thrive in a high-target environment, we want you on our team!

Goodgame Studiosis known for successful strategy titles and data-driven game development. We self-publish our games in-house and have all relevant professions under one roof. Plus, we are part ofStillfront Group, one of Europe’s leading game publishers with a strong focus on long-term IP growth.

  • Proposer à nos intérimaires des avantages exclusifs et un suivi personnalisé pour les accompagner en proximité et améliorer leurs conditions de vie.

Nos ambitions pour 2026 sont de devenir l’acteur de référence partout en France dans le recrutement d’experts pour les entreprises du BTP, et d'occuper une place de choix à l’international.

En parallèle, nous avons lancer l'Asap.academy qui est notre propre centre de formation et d'habilitation à destination de nos clients et intérimaires.

Si tu veux rejoindre une aventure ambitieuse et en pleine croissance, et avoir un très fort impact humain sur la vie de nos candidats, tu as frappé à la bonne porte !

Le poste :

ASAP Academy est un organisme de formation spécialisé dans les formations réglementaires BTP (habilitations électriques NF C 18-510, CACES, AIPR, ADR, PRAP, Port du Harnais, amiante). Certifié Qualiopi, nous accompagnons des entreprises du bâtiment, des travaux publics et des industries connexes dans la mise en conformité de leurs équipes.

Dans le cadre de notre croissance — avec l'ouverture d'un second centre de formation prévue en septembre 2026 et le développement d'une offre multi-sites — nous recrutons un Assistant de Gestion Formation pour structurer et fiabiliser notre back-office formation.

Nous rejoindre c'est rejoindre une équipe à taille humaine, en pleine structuration, avec des outils modernes et des process en cours d'automatisation.

✨ Tes missions :

Administration des sessions (flux quotidien)

  • Inscrire les apprenants sur LMS et assurer la complétude des dossiers d'entrée en formation

  • Générer et envoyer les documents obligatoires : conventions de formation, convocations, règlements intérieurs

  • Relancer les apprenants pour la collecte des émargements signés et des évaluations à chaud / à froid

  • Éditer les attestations de fin de formation et certificats de réalisation dans les délais réglementaires

  • Assurer la clôture administrative de chaque session en vérifiant l'exhaustivité du dossier

  • Editer et envoyer les factures aux clients

Gestion OPCO et prises en charge (mission clé)

  • Monter les dossiers de prise en charge auprès d'OPCO Atlas et autres financeurs (Constructys,etc…)

  • Suivre les dossiers de A à Z : dépôt, validation, encaissement, traitement des rejets

  • Relancer les impayés et assurer le suivi des remboursements OPCO en lien avec Pennylane

  • Gérer les dossiers CPF en lien avec Mon Compte Formation (vérification, rapprochement)

  • Traiter les rejets OPCO : identifier la pièce manquante, corriger et soumettre à nouveau sans délai

Coordination des sous-traitants et formateurs

  • Envoyer les demandes de disponibilité aux formateurs indépendants et aux OF partenaires

  • Centraliser les retours et planifier les sessions dans le planning LMS

  • Collecter et archiver les documents de conformité des sous-traitants : assurances, CV, certifications, contrats (LMS + Drive)

  • Coordonner la logistique multi-sites (matériel, salles, accès) pour les deux centres

Facturation et suivi financier

  • Éditer les factures clients sur Pennylane et s'assurer de leur envoi dans les délais

  • Réceptionner et vérifier les factures formateurs, préparer les éléments de règlement

  • Suivre les encaissements et alerter la direction sur les retards de paiement

Qualité et conformité Qualiopi

  • Classer rigoureusement chaque preuve dans les dossiers de sessions (émargements, évaluations, supports)

  • Veiller à l'exhaustivité des dossiers avant clôture — un dossier incomplet est un risque d'audit

  • Contribuer à la mise à jour des documents qualité en lien avec les indicateurs Qualiopi

  • Alerter la direction en cas d'écart ou de non-conformité détectée

👉 On te veut dans notre équipe car :

  • Tu as 3 ans minimum en organisme de formation et tu maîtrises des flux admin formation (conventions, émargements, attestations, OPCO)

  • Tu es à l'aise sur LMS et Pennylane (ou outil de facturation). Connaissance de Notion-Excel appréciée.

  • Tu connais le secteur du BTP

DIVERSITÉ & INCLUSION

Chez asap.work, nous nous engageons à promouvoir un environnement où la diversité et l'inclusion sont au cœur de nos valeurs. Notre objectif est d'attirer et de constituer une équipe diverse, équitable et inclusive, où chacun se sent le bienvenu. En tant qu'employeur qui favorise l'égalité des chances, nous veillons à ce que le processus de candidature et notre lieu de travail soient ouverts à tous.

CapsLock is a dynamic marketing company providing IT-enabled solutions for large North American partners. We specialize in scalable customer acquisition through data-driven marketing, creative production, and technology innovation.

Our teams collaborate across marketing, IT, analytics, and media buying to build, test, and optimize high-performing funnels that help clients achieve predictable growth across industries such as Home Improvement, Health, Legal, and Insurance.

Role Overview

We’re looking for an AI Video Editor Team Lead who is equal parts strong leader, project manager, systems builder, and editing geek — someone who knows how to automate workflows and achieve business goals through videos that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 to 7 editors and elevate them through mature management, strict quality control, and deep AI integration.

Core Responsibilities

Team & Project Management

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 7+ AI-driven video editors, identifying their core strengths and guiding them to new professional heights.
  • Monitor team morale and proactively manage workloads to prevent burnout, ensuring the team’s spirit aligns with the company culture.
  • Act as a strong Project Manager: own the task distribution process and handle complex project routing. Keep pipelines organized and ensure clean, on-time delivery.
  • Ensure strict Quality Control (QC). Every video must meet our high standards for pacing, visual fidelity, and hook impact.
  • Review, approve, and uphold internal guidelines and editing rules so the team has a clear operational framework.

AI Systems & Workflow Automation

  • Build systematized AI workflows. Create structured templates using tools like Weavy to speed up the team's execution.
  • Automate post-production. Build pipelines connecting task databases to AI generators, auto-delivering ready-to-edit assets directly, eliminating manual prompt copying and file downloading.
  • Integrate new AI tools. Regularly test emerging AI models and implement the most effective ones into the daily workflow.
  • Stay hands-on. Jump into the editing software (Adobe Suite) when needed to unblock the team, fix complex issues, or test new technical approaches.

Performance

  • Build and maintain a database of top-performing creatives to systematically scale and iterate on winning concepts.
  • Analyze failed creatives to understand what went wrong and make corrections for future videos.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and Marketers to align on technical feasibility, negotiate deadlines, and solve bottlenecks.
  • Actively participate in brainstorming sessions, pitching new visual formats and AI-driven approaches to turn creative hypotheses into reality.

Requirements

Requirements

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed video production/editing teams. (This is not a role for a senior editor looking for their first management gig).
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches.

You know exactly how to create realistic AI avatars with perfect lip-sync, generate missing footage from scratch, anduse AI to solve any production problem.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: Solid understanding of short-form video ads (Meta, TikTok, YouTube Shorts). You know what keeps viewers watching and what makes a video sell.
  • Fluent English — both spoken and written.

Remote Work

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

Home Office

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

Physical Well-Being

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

Unlimited Sick Days

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

Medical Coverage

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

Co-Working Space

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

Fun Stuff

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Service-Oriented Architect
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a seasoned Microservices Architect to lead the design and evolution of large-scale microservices ecosystems built on modern container platforms and cloud-native technology stacks. The role requires deep expertise in service decomposition, domain-driven design, distributed data management, and runtime concerns such as resilience, observability, and security at scale. The ideal candidate brings hands-on architectural leadership across complex transformations, with a clear point of view on when microservices are the right answer, how to evolve them safely, and how to keep the resulting estate maintainable over the long term.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define microservices architecture standards, service boundaries, and decomposition strategies aligned with domain-driven design principles.
  • Lead the modernization of legacy monoliths into well-bounded, independently deployable services with clear ownership.
  • Design service communication patterns leveraging REST, gRPC, asynchronous messaging, and event streaming as appropriate.
  • Establish API contracts, schema governance, and versioning strategies that enable safe evolution of services over time.
  • Architect resilient distributed systems incorporating circuit breakers, retries, bulkheads, and graceful degradation patterns.
  • Define data ownership models, transactional boundaries, and patterns such as outbox, saga, and CQRS where appropriate.
  • Lead the design of platform capabilities including service mesh, API gateway, identity propagation, and shared observability.
  • Drive performance engineering, capacity planning, and scalability analysis across critical service domains.
  • Establish CI/CD, testing, and deployment standards optimized for high-frequency, low-risk service releases.
  • Define observability standards including structured logging, distributed tracing, and SLO-driven monitoring.

raw.description:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.
If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

As a critical extension of our clients’ HR teams, we navigate and advise on the intricate paths of global employment with unmatched speed, expertise, and precision. The vision of the Lifecycle team at Remote is not just about maintaining the gold standard in HR practices; it’s about elevating it, integrating cutting-edge technology solutions, and enriching customer experiences in over 80+ countries. On this team, your work directly influences our ability to sustain and extend our compliance coverage, continuously enhance our customer journeys, and significantly increase our operational capacity. You’re not just part of a team; you’re at the forefront of shaping the future of work, ensuring every interaction is fast, intuitive, and profoundly impactful. Dive into a role where your passion for innovation, commitment to excellence, and drive to make a global difference aligns with our mission to empower organizations worldwide to employ anyone, anywhere — compliantly.

The Senior Lifecycle Specialist, Employee Relations & Transitions independently manages all employee exits for Remote's external employees with a focus on legal compliance, excellent quality and providing delightful customer service. Additionally, the specialist provides first-level Employee Relations support, guiding clients through workplace concerns and coordinating appropriate resources.

As part of a larger employee Lifecycle team, the Senior Specialist is also expected to drive process improvements and initiatives in line with Remote's strategic goals and values.

Key Responsibilities

Offboarding

  • Manage and resolve complex end-to-end employee exits with minimal supervision across multiple international jurisdictions, prioritizing a superior offboarding experience for Remote's clients and employees.
  • Provide sound and trusted guidance with an elevated level of knowledge on key jurisdictions, and manage clients' requests on various HR matters, including but not limited to termination, resignation and transfer procedures, employment contracts, and redundancy processes, ensuring legal compliance and best practices.
  • Independently lead and facilitate meetings with clients and external employees, including but not limited to workforce reduction consultation meetings, administrative hearings, negotiations in separations and settlements, providing guidance on terminations, and delivering termination outcomes.
  • Influence and negotiate positive outcomes in complex terminations, successfully navigating and directing multiple stakeholders with competing interests through a complicated, involved and sometimes lengthy process.
  • Liaise with and coordinate various internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance in offboarding activities and audits, including but not limited to payroll, legal counsel, government bodies, and trade unions.
  • Draft, tailor and administer all termination and supplementary documents with accuracy and attention to detail, ensuring employee records are maintained with strict adherence to privacy and confidentiality regulations.
  • Process offboarding on Remote's internal HRIS platform, collaborating with various internal stakeholders, such as Customer Success, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Time and Attendance, among other verticals, to ensure all aspects of the employee exit are administered correctly and promptly.
  • Act as the first point of informal escalation as a trusted colleague with good judgment, by way of providing expertise, mentoring and guidance to more junior team members.
  • Provide comprehensive guidance on Remote's Employee Relations resources, helping clients navigate complex workplace scenarios.
  • Conduct thorough preliminary assessments of workplace concerns, identifying key facts, applicable local regulations, and potential paths forward.
  • Serve as a trusted resource for internal and external stakeholders on employee relations matters, ensuring appropriate handling of complex cases.
  • Guide clients in understanding progressive disciplinary approaches, documentation requirements, and best practices for handling difficult situations.
  • Track and monitor ongoing employee relations cases, ensuring timely follow-up and appropriate coordination with relevant stakeholders.
  • Be the subject-matter expert and proactively resolve internal and external queries on all offboarding and first-level employee relations matters in conjunction with Lifecycle's internal stakeholders.
  • Actively identify opportunities, advocate for and drive process improvements, automation, product development and overall customer and employee experience through the offboarding and employee relations processes.
  • Determine methods, procedures and standards on new assignments. Exercise judgment in selecting methods, evaluating, adapting complex techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results taking into account wider Lifecycle and Remote needs.

Key Requirements and Charactristics

  • Experience as an HR Advisor or HR Business Partner, with generalist HR competencies and exposure across the employee lifecycle.
  • Tertiary qualifications in HR/labour relations/employment law considered a plus.
  • Proven experience with a strong background in independently managing voluntary and involuntary exits (terminations) with care, sensitivity and legal compliance; and providing comprehensive HR advice and guidance on employment laws and regulations, spanning various jurisdictions.
  • Understanding of employee relations principles, progressive discipline approaches, and workplace investigation fundamentals.
  • Ability to interpret and apply industrial instruments, analyze complex HR issues and apply problem-solving skills to independently (occasionally with minimal supervision) arrive at solutions, undertake research and translate this into usable team resources, provide practical solutions and effectively communicate recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders when operating in ambiguous and unfamiliar environments.
  • Superior communication, influencing, conflict management, and negotiation skills, with the ability to independently lead difficult conversations to a positive outcome, often where parties have conflicting interests, while conveying authority and expertise as the representative of Remote, and maintaining professionalism and strict confidentiality.
  • Business-level (advanced) proficiency in written and spoken English, with additional languages considered a plus.
  • Aptitude and appetite to innovate and optimize processes, continuously identifying, developing and implementing opportunities for automation and champion best practice.
  • Efficiency in operations, with an awareness of the importance of thorough record-keeping and data integrity.
  • Tech-savvy, with the ability to successfully collaborate asynchronously on various tools, and adapt to new and evolving systems.
  • Ability to work autonomously and cohesively in an international team in a fast-paced, asynchronous, remote environment while successfully balancing multiple competing priorities. Willingness to work flexible hours as needed.
  • Proactive and self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability, and ability to inspire others.
  • Demonstrates strong automation and AI capabilities and AI fluency.

Practicals

  • You'll report to: Manager Employee Lifecycle, Employee Relations & Transitions
  • Team: Lifecycle, Employee Relations & Transitions
  • Location: APAC

Application process

  1. Interview with recruiter
  2. Take Home Exercise
  3. Interview with future manager
  4. Interview with team members (no managers present)
  5. Interview with Senior Manager
  6. Bar Raiser
  7. Prior employment verification check

Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

The annual salary range for this full-time position is
$46,500—$117,750 USD

Benefits

Our full benefits & perks are explained in our handbook at remote.com/r/benefits. As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters:
  • work from anywhere
  • flexible paid time off
  • flexible working hours (we are async)
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • mental health support services
  • stock options
  • learning budget
  • home office budget & IT equipment
  • budget for local in-person social events or co-working spaces

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at remote.com/async.

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

If that sounds like something you want, apply now!

How to apply

  1. Please fill out the form below and upload your CV with a PDF format.
  2. We kindly ask you to submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use here at Remote.
  3. If you don’t have an up to date CV but you are still interested in talking to us, please feel free to add a copy of your LinkedIn profile instead.

Not only do we encourage folks from all ethnic groups, genders, sexuality, age, abilities, disability status and any other under-represented group to apply, but we prioritize a sense of belonging. We have 4 ERGs (Women, Disability, Queer, Minorities in Tech) who meet regularly with the People team. During your interviews and beyond, we ask & encourage anybody who needs an accommodation to request one from their recruiter.

We will ask you to voluntarily tell us your pronouns at interview stage, and you will have the option to answer our anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply below. As an equal employment opportunity employer it’s important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and this data will help us to stay accountable. We thank you for providing this data, if you chose to.

At Remote, we embrace AI as a valuable tool while prioritizing human creativity and authenticity. We look forward to meeting candidates who balance innovation with genuine expertise and experience. To learn more about Remote's AI guidelines check see here.

Please note we accept applications on an ongoing basis.

raw.description:
The work we do has an impact on millions of lives, and you can be a part of it.
We help protect our customers against life’s uncertainties. Regardless of where you work within the company, you’ll be helping provide protection and peace of mind when our customers need it most.

The National Account Manager, Affinity Partnerships serves as the executive relationship leader responsible for the overall success, growth, profitability and strategic management of the affinity partnership between the American Dental Association (ADA) and Protective, and also oversees the sales and marketing distribution relationship with Alliant Insurance Services.

This position owns the strategic and operational relationship between both organizations, ensuring alignment of business objectives, group benefits strategy, marketing initiatives, sales performance, and member engagement. Acting as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, the Account Manager drives profitable program growth through strategic planning, business analysis, and cross-functional collaboration while influencing stakeholders across multiple organizations.

The role requires a solid understanding of group employee benefits, insurance distribution to individual consumers, affinity marketing, and account management, along with the ability to develop business strategies that increase participation, revenue, profitability and long-term partnership value. While this position does not directly manage underwriting or sales teams, it is accountable for overall program performance through leadership, influence, and disciplined business management.

Essential Responsibilities

Strategic Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner between the American Dental Association and Protective
  • Serve as the primary relationship owner between Protective and Alliant Insurance Services.
  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for the ADA and Alliant to internal teams
  • Build and maintain trusted executive relationships with key stakeholders across both organizations.
  • Align strategic priorities, business objectives, and growth initiatives.
  • Identify emerging opportunities and proactively resolve business challenges.
  • Represent the partnership during executive meetings, planning sessions, and strategic business reviews both internally and with the ADA.

Business Growth & Sales Strategy

  • Monitor market trends, competitive activity, and ADA member needs to inform business strategy.
  • Communicate and collaborate with ADA on business strategy at regular meetings with ADA Staff in Chicago dedicated to the programs and bi-annual meetings with the ADA Council of Members Insurance and Retirement programs (CMIRP).
  • Facilitate cross-functional teams to develop an integrated annual business plan, focused on profitable growth, expense management and increased member participation.
  • Establish annual sales objectives for Alliant
  • Serve as a strategic internal advisor on ADA offerings and insurance programs. Recommend and champion new products, services, and initiatives that strengthen the partnership and enhance member value.

Financial & Business Performance

  • Maintain accountability for the overall financial health and performance of the ADA business, partnering with Product, Actuarial and Finance.
  • Monitor and analyze:
    • Sales performance
    • Policyholder retention and experience trends
    • Product competitiveness
    • Distribution effectiveness (Alliant)
    • Operational expense efficiency
    • Profitability & surplus
  • Develop executive dashboards and business performance reports
  • Partner with finance and leadership on forecasting, budgeting, and long-range planning.
  • Provide recommendations that improve profitability, operational effectiveness, and long-term business performance.

Executive Governance & Program Management

  • Facilitate quarterly business reviews and annual strategic planning sessions externally and internally
  • Prepare executive presentations, scorecards, and strategic updates.
  • Track initiatives, action plans, and organizational commitments.
  • Drive accountability across multiple departments and partner organizations.
  • Ensure execution of strategic priorities through effective project management and influence.
  • Communicate program results to the ADA at bi-annual CMIRP meetings, regular ADA Staff meetings and through a formal annual Report of Administrators.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree required. Preferably in Business Administration or a related field (Insurance)

Experience

  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in strategic account management, affinity program management, insurance consulting, broker relationship management, or executive client management.
  • Experience managing large, complex client or association relationships.
  • Demonstrated success driving revenue growth, member engagement, and business profitability.
  • Experience collaborating with insurance carriers, brokers, consultants, and employer-sponsored benefit programs.
  • Experience leading executive-level business reviews and strategic planning initiatives.
  • Exceptional executive communication and presentation skills.
  • Strong business and financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, and profit-and-loss management.
  • Working knowledge of group benefits underwriting, renewal strategies, employee benefits funding arrangements, and insurance marketplace dynamics preferred.
Employee Benefits:
We aim to protect the wellbeing of our employees and their families with a broad benefits offering. In addition to offering comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance, we support emotional wellbeing through mental health benefits and an employee assistance program. Work/life balance is important and Protective offers a variety of paid time away benefits (e.g., paid time off, paid parental leave, short-term disability, and a cultural observance day). The financial health of our employees is just as important as physical and emotional health. Some of the financial wellbeing benefits include contributions to healthcare accounts, a pension plan, and a 401(k) plan with Company matching. All employees are encouraged to protect their overall wellbeing by engaging in ProHealth Rewards, Protective’s platform to improve wellbeing while earning cash rewards.
Eligibility for certain benefits may vary by position in accordance with the terms of the Company’s benefit plans.
Accommodations for Applicants with a Disability:
If you require an accommodation to complete the application and recruitment process due to a disability, please email eric.hess@protective.com. This information will be held in confidence and used only to determine an appropriate accommodation for the application and recruitment process.
Please note that the above email is solely for individuals with disabilities requesting an accommodation. General employment questions should not be sent through this process.
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to being inclusive and attracting, retaining, and growing an inclusive workforce.

raw.excerpt: Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven is the world’s largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us.
raw.description:
Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven is the world’s largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Maven’s award-winning digital programs provide clinical, emotional, and financial support all in one platform, spanning fertility & family building, maternity & newborn care, parenting & pediatrics, and menopause. Employers and health plans trust Maven’s end-to-end platform to improve clinical outcomes, reduce healthcare costs, and provide equity in benefits programs.

At Maven, we believe better care can’t wait. Together, we can make sure it doesn’t have to. We provide you with the flexibility and support you need to do your best work— so you can deliver the compassionate, evidence-based care women and families need now more than ever.

Maven Clinic has been recognized as a leader in healthcare, culture, and innovation, receiving awards leading authorities across several industries, including:

  • FORTUNE #1 Best Workplace in Healthcare
  • Fast Company #1 Most Innovative Company in Health
  • Great Place to Work certified
  • Inc. Best Workplaces
  • Becker’s Hospital Review, 150 Top Places to Work in Healthcare
  • Best Virtual Clinic, Medtech Breakthrough Awards

About This Role

Maven is seeking a mission-driven, empathetic Reproductive & Fertility Nurse based in Europe to provide virtual care and support to our members.

As a Maven provider, you will support members around the world, helping expand access to high-quality reproductive healthcare through virtual care. You will join a curated global provider network spanning 30+ specialties and 350+ subspecialties, working collaboratively to deliver holistic, high-value care.

As our member community continues to grow across 175+ countries, we are expanding our international provider network to ensure members have access to high-quality, culturally responsive care. If you are passionate about improving clinical outcomes, advancing evidence-based care, and delivering compassionate, patient-centred reproductive health services, we encourage you to apply.

What You'll Do

Provide virtual care to adult members through 15-minute video consultations and asynchronous messaging, including:

  • Guidance throughout the fertility journey, including fertility assessments, diagnostic investigations
  • Education on potential causes of infertility
  • Guidance on questions to discuss with NHS or private fertility specialists
  • Support in selecting appropriate fertility clinics and understanding NHS and private fertility treatment pathways
  • Document encounter summaries in MPractice, Maven's secure practice management platform
  • Collaborate with Maven's Care Delivery team to coordinate appropriate follow-up care and referrals within members' local healthcare systems
  • Serve as an ambassador for Maven's care model by delivering culturally sensitive, evidence-based support and championing improved outcomes for women and families globally

Who You Are

  • Hold current nursing registration with the UK Nursing and Midwifery Council (NMC) and/or an equivalent recognised nursing registration in Europe as a Registered Nurse (RN), Advanced Nurse Practitioner (ANP), Nurse Practitioner (NP), or an equivalent advanced practice qualification (e.g., MSc in Advanced Clinical Practice)
  • Based in Europe
  • Fluent in both English and Spanish (spoken and written)
  • In good standing with your relevant regulatory body, with no history of serious disciplinary action, fitness-to-practise concerns, or restrictions on practice
  • Available to provide approximately 5 hours of direct member care per week in a part-time, independent contractor capacity
  • At least 3 years of post-registration clinical experience as an independently practising nurse or advanced practice clinician
  • At least 3 years of experience delivering care through telehealth, digital health, or other remote care settings
  • Demonstrated clinical experience or a strong professional interest in women's health, reproductive health, or fertility care
  • Comfortable delivering patient-centred care through digital platforms and asynchronous communication

Opportunity Highlights

  • Flexibility
    • Meet with members virtually, when and where it is convenient for you.
  • Grow Your Practice
    • Supplement your existing practice through Maven's secure, proprietary telehealth platform:
    • Provide care via video consultations and private messaging.
    • Participate in additional opportunities, including moderating community forums, leading virtual member classes, and writing or reviewing educational content.
    • Receive referrals for in-person care when appropriate.
  • Training & Professional Development
    • Participate in optional Maven-sponsored lectures, panel discussions, and other speaking opportunities.

Benefits & Perks:

Our provider network delivers exceptional care to our members, 24/7/365. At Maven, we understand the quality of the provider experience is inextricably linked to the quality of patient experience. When you work with Maven, you’ll do some of the most impactful work of your career with a support system that includes the team, flexibility, tools, and tech you need to unlock the highest standard of care. You’ll have:

  • The opportunity to connect with 30+ specialty types
  • A support system, including a Care Support Team, to answer your questions, handle paperwork, manage referrals and ensure continuity of care
  • The opportunity to serve Maven members around the globe, with language and care matching services
  • Membership in a world-class network of health and clinical experts across fields

We seek and embrace experts from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to mirror and better care for our ever-growing member base.

Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at security@mavenclinic.com. For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com.

raw.title: Senior Technical Product Manager - AI Platform, Remote
raw.excerpt: Aledade is dedicated to transforming value-based care through innovative technology.
raw.description:
Aledade is dedicated to transforming value-based care through innovative technology. Our AI Platform team is at the forefront of this mission, building foundational tools, services, and infrastructure that empower internal product teams to seamlessly integrate cutting-edge AI capabilities into Aledade’s products and develop powerful internal AI solutions.
As a Senior Technical Product Manager on the AI Platform team, you will:
  • Define and deliver the roadmap to drive execution and scale of new AI capabilities that support internal stakeholders and external AI products.
  • Operate at the intersection of machine learning systems, data engineering, and applied healthcare AI.
  • Partner closely with AI engineers, data scientists, and clinical leadership to scale AI concepts from experiments to production-grade systems that support reliable inference pipelines across millions of patient records.
  • Contribute to the improvement of quality and cost of care for over 2 million patients served by Aledade providers.

Primary Duties:

  • Partner with business owners to cultivate a shared vision for the problem space, constraints, priorities, and ideal end state, and be able to articulate and advocate for this perspective.
  • Lead the full lifecycle of ML and LLM platform workstreams—from data ingestion, training, and deployment to ongoing optimization of live user workflows based on performance metrics and feedback.
  • Work with internal teams and end users to develop a deep understanding of requirements, perform thoughtful solution design, use data to test hypotheses, and support teams throughout execution.
  • Write detailed user stories for new features, capturing descriptions of business rationale, requirements, and success criteria defined by measurable outcomes.
  • Develop short- and long-term roadmaps that deliver maximum value with minimum risk and assume ongoing iteration.
  • Partner with AI Researchers to mature proofs-of-concept into production-ready capabilities; perform exploration of user feedback, healthcare records, and validation data to validate model performance.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of product management experience in technology, technology-enabled services, or SaaS.
  • Strong understanding of artificial intelligence and/or machine learning technologies.
  • Experience using data and primary research to inform solution design and build business understanding.
  • Familiarity with Agile teams, Jira, and the software development lifecycle.
  • Knowledge of APIs, DevOps, enterprise software development, and cloud infrastructure (e.g., Databricks, AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Understanding of data engineering principles.
  • Ability to communicate technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Skilled at translating ambiguous product requirements into a technical roadmap.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills and/or Abilities:

  • Experience in healthcare technology environments, particularly physician-facing products or work with clinical datasets (EHR, Claims, Population Health datasets).
  • Clinical Data Literacy: Familiarity with EHR data, Claims, or population health datasets.
  • Demonstrated track record of taking products from 0 to 1, driving concepts from ideation through market launch and scale
  • Experience leading AI/ML platform products and scaling platforms vertically and horizontally.
  • Track record of building and launching AI/ML platforms, tools, or internal services.
  • Deep knowledge of AI/ML product lifecycle, MLOps, and scalable AI infrastructure (training, deployment, monitoring, observability, reliability).
  • Experience with large language models (LLMs) and generative AI technologies, including prompt engineering strategies and VLMs.
  • Fluency in translating technical concepts into value propositions and storytelling for diverse stakeholders.

Physical Requirements:

  • Sitting for prolonged periods of time. Extensive use of computers and keyboards. Occasional walking and lifting may be required.

Who We Are:

Aledade, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.

What Does This Mean for You?

At Aledade, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.
In addition to time off to support work-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:
Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles
Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners
Robust time-off plan (21 days of PTO in your first year)
Two paid volunteer days and 11 paid holidays
12 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents
Six weeks paid sabbatical after six years of service
Educational Assistant Program and Clinical Employee Reimbursement Program
401(k) with up to 4% match
Stock options

raw.description:
Data Science at TRACTIAN

The Data Science team at TRACTIAN focuses on extracting valuable insights from vast amounts of industrial data. Using advanced statistical methods, algorithms, and data visualization techniques, this team transforms raw data into actionable intelligence that drives decision-making across engineering, product development, and operational strategies. The team constantly works on optimizing prediction models, identifying trends, and providing data-driven solutions that directly enhance the company’s operational efficiency and the quality of its products.

What you'll do

As a Data Scientist - Predictive Maintenance at TRACTIAN, you will work at the intersection of advanced data science and industrial operations. Your mission is to develop cutting-edge algorithms and predictive models to monitor and predict equipment failures before they occur, optimizing asset reliability and reducing downtime. You’ll face complex challenges involving large-scale time-series data, real-time data processing, and machine learning applications, while collaborating closely with engineers and laboratory teams to ensure our predictive maintenance solutions remain industry-leading.

Responsibilities

  • Develop predictive maintenance algorithms using machine learning techniques for time-series data.
  • Analyze sensor data streams to identify patterns that predict equipment failure.
  • Research and stay up to date with academic literature and state-of-the-art condition monitoring techniques, translating relevant advances into practical solutions.
  • Collaborate with engineers to improve data pipelines and enhance model accuracy.
  • Build scalable, real-time models for low-latency predictions.
  • Create diagnostic tools that enable data-driven maintenance decisions.
  • Work with the laboratory team to design experiments and develop failure datasets using real machinery to validate hypotheses, develop new models, and optimize existing ones.
  • Continuously refine models based on real-world performance, experimental results, and feedback.

Requirements

  • Expertise in machine learning, time-series analysis, and anomaly detection.
  • Proficiency in Python and common data science and ML libraries (e.g., NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch).
  • Solid understanding of signal processing concepts and hands-on experience with industrial sensor data (e.g., vibration, current, temperature, pressure).
  • Ability to read, interpret, and apply insights from academic literature and state-of-the-art research in condition monitoring and fault diagnosis.
  • Experience designing experiments to validate hypotheses and benchmark models.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to handle noisy, high-dimensional data.
  • Advanced English.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with both academic research and real-world applications in condition monitoring, fault diagnosis, and prognostics (e.g., vibration-based methods, model-based vs. data-driven approaches).
  • Experience translating academic methods into robust, production-ready algorithms.
  • Prior experience working in industrial or manufacturing environments.

Why WarriorBabe?
At WarriorBabe, we believe in the power of dedication and personal growth. You'll be surrounded by a vibrant team that shares your passion for fitness and helping women flourish. Together, we are on a mission to transform lives and create a community that thrives on empowerment.

Offering personalized macronutrient plans and workout programming, WarriorBabe ensures each woman's unique needs are met. With one-on-one coaching, a dedicated mobile app, and a vibrant online community, WarriorBabe provides the tools and support necessary for lasting success. Ideal for women of all ages and fitness levels, WarriorBabe adapts to ensure continuous progress and achievement of fitness goals.

Our Mission

Help 100,000 women regain their personal power and feel confident in their skin.

About the Role
We're looking for competitive, resilient, high-output sales professionals who love the hunt.

At WarriorBabe, our Outbound Setters spend the majority of their workday on the phone. This is a high-volume outbound sales role where you'll make 500+ outbound dials every day, have hundreds of conversations every week, handle rejection with confidence, and consistently create opportunities for women who are ready to transform their lives.

If you're looking for a role where you're making a few calls between meetings, this isn't it.

If you love the chase, enjoy competing against your own numbers, and find satisfaction in making "one more call," you'll probably love it here.

This isn't a customer service role.

This is outbound sales, and the people who succeed here are disciplined, coachable, resilient, and obsessed with improving their numbers every single week.

This Role Is For You If...

✅ You genuinely enjoy being on the phone all day.

✅ You don't mind making 500+ outbound dials every single day.

✅ Rejection motivates you instead of discouraging you.

✅ You love chasing goals, leaderboards, and performance metrics.

✅ You enjoy talking to strangers and starting conversations.

✅ You want your paycheck to reflect your performance.

This Role Is NOT For You If...

❌ You dislike cold calling.

❌ You get mentally drained after hearing "no."

❌ You prefer a slower-paced workday with meetings, projects, or administrative work.

❌ You're looking for an account management or customer success role.

❌ You don't enjoy spending the majority of your day on the phone.

What You'll Do

  • Generate qualified sales appointments through high-volume outbound prospecting.
  • Spend the majority of your workday making 500+ outbound dials and engaging prospective WarriorBabe clients by phone.
  • Build relationships and create interest with prospective clients.
  • Consistently execute outbound call campaigns and follow-up sequences.
  • Qualify leads and schedule appointments for our Sales Team.
  • Maintain accurate CRM notes and pipeline management.
  • Meet and exceed daily activity and performance goals.
  • Work closely with leadership to continuously improve your performance.

Compensation

This is a performance-based role designed to reward both activity and quality.

Base Compensation: $3,600 per month.

Base compensation is earned by consistently meeting the minimum expectations of the role, including:

  • Required daily outbound activity
  • Consistent talk time and productivity
  • Appropriate management of idle and pause time
  • Accurate CRM and pipeline management
  • Compliance with all outreach and Do Not Call requirements

In addition to your monthly base, you'll get performance earnings:

  • $4 for every Qualified Booked Call
  • $10 for every Qualified Show
  • +$8 Accelerator for every Qualified Booked Call above your daily goal of 8 appointments
  • 0.5% commission on closed cash generated from your personally booked opportunities

There is no cap on performance earnings.

Most successful Setters earn approximately:

  • $3,600/month base compensation
  • $650+/month in Qualified Booked Call incentives
  • $1,200+/month in Qualified Show incentives
  • Additional accelerator earnings for exceeding daily booking goals
  • Additional commission equal to 0.5% of closed cash generated

Expected On-Target Earnings (OTE): $65,000-$70,000+ annually.

Top performers who consistently exceed daily booking targets and generate high-quality opportunities have significant upside beyond expected OTE.

What Success Looks Like

This is a numbers game and our best Setters embrace it.

Every day you'll be expected to:

  • Make 500+ outbound dials
  • Spend the majority of your shift actively prospecting
  • Book 8+ qualified appointments
  • Maintain 20%+ Sales Per Booking (SPB)
  • Execute follow-up without letting opportunities fall through the cracks
  • Keep your CRM accurate and organized

The more conversations you create, the more opportunities you generate, and the more you earn.

Performance Expectations

Your success is measured by both activity and quality.

Daily Expectations

📞 500+ outbound dials

📅 8+ qualified appointments booked

💰 20%+ Sales Per Booking (SPB)

📋 CRM updated throughout the day

☎️ Consistent follow-up and call cadence execution

Performance is also evaluated based on:

  • Qualified booking volume
  • Show rate
  • Sales conversion from personally generated opportunities
  • Outbound activity and productivity
  • Pipeline and CRM management
  • Compliance and overall quality of opportunities generated

We're Looking For Someone Who...

  • Has 2-3+ years of sales experience.
  • Has outbound SDR, appointment setting, or high-volume phone sales experience.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, high-performance sales environment.
  • Is resilient and doesn't take rejection personally.
  • Is highly coachable and welcomes feedback.
  • Loves competing against goals, scoreboards, and KPIs.
  • Wants to be rewarded for performance and growth.

Schedule

  • Five workdays per week (Monday-Friday or Wednesday-Sunday, depending on business needs)
  • Eight-hour shifts
  • Fourteen (14) days' notice required for planned PTO
  • Reliable attendance is expected

Why WarriorBabe?

We're building one of the fastest-growing brands in women's health.

Every day, we help women over 40 become stronger, healthier, and more confident through world-class coaching, nutrition, and accountability.

If you're looking for a place where performance is rewarded, growth is expected, and your work genuinely changes lives, you'll fit right in.

Ready to build something bigger than yourself? We'd love to meet you.
